descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations
Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring, and managing your team to meet goals. Amazon provides extensive training and development to become an exceptional people leader. As a people manager, you will ensure that your team has all the tools needed to succeed and maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance and performance at work.

Visit this page to find more information on each of our building types. https://www.aboutamazon.com/workplace/facilities

Please note we are not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered.

This posting encompasses all openings in the country. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Relocation benefits are offered at time of offer to eligible candidates.

Benefits: Medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Visit this page to learn more about the benefits Amazon offers.
https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/benefits


Key job responsibilities
• Support, mentor and motivate 50-100 direct report Amazon Associates.
• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.
• Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours.
• Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off.
• Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT. equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach.
• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.
Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.
Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.
End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Basic qualifications

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a bachelor’s or master’s degree. (You must have all degree requirements met before your first day).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's program for Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
· Mentor and train Facilities team members on operation and control of the BMS and EPMS systems.
· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
· Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with the BMS and EPMS in data centers.
· Perform provisioning process for servers, controllers, industrial PCs and network configurations and communication testing between third party devices and controllers or servers.
· Installation, replacement, configuration, and calibration of sensors.
· Able to read and understand Electrical schematics, control panel drawings. Basic understanding of close loop controls, field sensors scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
· Supervise low voltage electrical contractors who performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
· Commissioning and systems level testing support.
· Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
· Follow change management process to generate work requests and method of procedures.
· Participate in Factory witnessed tests at vendor's or panel builder's facility.
· Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.
· Recommend design improvements based on consultation with users and system operation.
· Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required and respond to after-hours emergencies.
· Perform service activities such as monitoring/reviewing ticketing systems, performing root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
· Actively manage service agreements to include vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Physical Requirements:

· Walk jobsites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Technical (Military/ Trade School) School diploma or Associate degree with one year experience related to industrial instrumentation/controls or equivalent electrical or mechanical operations experience.
- Minimum one year of experience working with computer components and operating systems.
- Minimum one year of experience with mission critical low and medium voltage electrical and/or mechanical systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred Qualifications:
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, controllers, and programming including troubleshooting of industrial controls analog, discrete and networked input/output field signals.
- One-year experience working in a Data Center or mission critical environment.
- Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or relevant discipline.
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.

title: ファシリティエンジニア -  DCEO（データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ）, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
DCEO (データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ) 部門では、ファシリティエンジニア・技術者を広く募集しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）のデータセンターを支える、施設内の電力設備や冷却設備などを安定稼働させることが責務です。DCEOの一員として、サーバーやネットワークなどのIT機器を収容する施設で働くことで、お客様のアプリケーションやWebサイトなどの稼働を24時間365日継続できるよう、社会インフラに貢献できる業務です。

弊社は 2006 年の設立以来、クラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアとして、ITインフラの世界に変革をもたらしました。現在は世界中で何百ものデータセンターを運営しており、急成長中の新興企業、大企業、主要な政府機関など、何百万ものお客様をサポートしています。データセンターがあることで、日本だけでなく世界中でクラウドコンピューティングサービスが利用できるようになり、お客様に信頼していただいている弊社の革新的な技術にいつでもアクセスできるようになっているのです。

本ポジションでは、世界最大級のITインフラの維持管理業務に関わる事ができます。そしてあなたがデータセンターのキャリア形成に必要なトレーニングやスキルをご提供します。データセンターでのキャリアにご興味ある方は是非ご応募ください！

#aws-jp-dc-ap

Key job responsibilities

* お客様のダウンタイムを最小限に抑えるための設備障害対応
* 設備の故障や保守、拡張等に伴う技術的な問題の調査、解決
* データセンターで使われている機器の設置や撤去

A day in the life
* データセンター内のオフィス、サーバー室、空調機械室、電気室等様々な場所を移動しながら、他のメンバーと一緒に　シフト勤務で、お客様のためにクラウドコンピューティングを24時間365日稼働が継続できるよう取り組みます。
* データセンター内の機械及び電気設備の監視および制御を行います。
* メンテナンス作業を安全かつスムーズに行うために、計画を立案して万全の準備を行います。
* 機器のメンテナンスサービスを提供するベンダーを管理します。
* データセンターで使用されるサーバーやハードウェア機器の設置や取り外し、及びその他の部品や消耗品の配送などを行うチームと協力して作業します。
* 施設のオペレーションコストの削減に取り組みながら、イノベーションを推進します。

About the team
データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズでは、日々安全とセキュリティ、そしてお客様に最高のクラウド体験を提供することに取り組んでいます。私たちはお客様のニーズとビジネス上の要求を満たすために、施設と設備の運用及び保守を担当しています。またアマゾンでは社員がトレーニングや認定を受けるための支援や、英語学習のサポートを提供しています。

Inclusive Team Culture
私たちのインクルーシブな文化は、あなたがお客様に最高の結果をもたらすことを可能にします。私たちは従業員の多様性を称えるだけでなく、多様な働き方を称賛しています。

Mentorship and Career growth
あなたのこれまでのご経験にかかわらず、ご活躍いただけるキャリアパスを用意しています。先輩社員からの知識の共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリアアップに役立つリソースが準備されており、より総合的なプロフェッショナルへの成長を支援します。

Location
首都圏（東京都・千葉県・神奈川県）のいずれかに所在するデータセンター （採用担当者より最寄り駅からのおおまかな通勤所要時間などを面接前にお伝えします。）

title: Sr. Advanced Manufacturing Engineer – Modeling & Drafting, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is seeking a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer with advanced 3D modeling and 2D drafting expertise to join our Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team. You will leverage deep proficiency in CAD modeling and production drawing creation to oversee the transition of complex self governed robotic systems from design to production, applying Design for Excellence (DfX) principles across a global supply chain.

The Amazon Robotics (AR) Operations organization manufactures high-quality robotics and gets the right materials to the right place at the right time to enable our automated solutions. It's a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon globally, and is powered by data and performance indicators.

Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply manufacturing technology in robotics and software to solve real-world problems that will transform our customers' experiences. We invent new improvements every day. We will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

This role will report to the Head of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering. You will be responsible for applying advanced modeling and drafting skills alongside DfX principles to influence product designs and transition a wide range of self governed robotic solutions from design to production. You will create and interpret complex 3D models and 2D production drawings, work cross-functionally to develop suppliers, manage product lifecycle changes, oversee manufacturing readiness assessments, and drive technical root cause for supplier defects. The successful candidate will combine expert-level CAD proficiency with broad manufacturing engineering knowledge, and be willing to "roll up sleeves and do what needs to get done" to consistently deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, review, and redline complex 3D parametric models and 2D production drawings to ensure manufacturability, proper tolerancing, and compliance with GD&T standards.
- Provide Design for Excellence (DfX) guidance and feedback on electromechanical designs at concept and detailed design phases, leveraging modeling expertise to validate design intent.
- Develop detailed manufacturing-intent drawings and model-based definitions (MBD) to communicate critical-to-quality features to suppliers.
- Guide best practices on manufacturing tolerances using GD&T; perform tolerance stack-up analyses using 3D models to identify interference and assembly risks.
- Launch tooling with accelerated schedules. Assess project risk and drive mitigation plans using model-based simulations.
- Review external production processes, identify risk, and mitigate — using 2D drafting deliverables to clearly define supplier requirements.
- Qualify production processes based on dimensional data, control plans, and process capability (Cpk) requirements.
- Drive internal and external PFMEA and DFMEA reviews, referencing model geometry and drawing specifications.
- Solve technical problems across a broad set of manufacturing commodities (mechanical and electrical).
- Guide manufacturing readiness assessments (MRL) for NPI programs through production ramp.
- Evaluate and approve Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) across mechanical and electrical commodities, assessing manufacturing, supply chain, and cost impacts — authoring or revising drawings and models as needed.
- Evaluate production, supplier, and field failures for root cause analysis and resolution using 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone methodologies.
- Mentor team members and design engineers on producibility best practices, drafting standards, and modeling techniques.
- Propose design changes that will enhance product sustainability and scalability, producing updated models and drawings to support implementation.
- Shepherd Statistical Process Control (SPC) implementation at suppliers; conduct Gauge R&R and process capability studies.
- Up to 30% travel required.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer on the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering team, you'll start your day in CAD — reviewing 3D models for manufacturability concerns and redlining 2D drawings to refine GD&T callouts before releasing to suppliers. Mid-morning, you might join a design review with hardware engineers, using your modeling expertise to flag tolerance stack-up risks, recommend geometry changes, or drive cost-out through design simplification. After lunch, you could be generating production-intent drawings for a new tooling package, guiding a PFMEA session with a key supplier, or analyzing SPC data to qualify a new production tool. You'll collaborate daily with cross-functional stakeholders across Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management, and you'll see the direct impact of your modeling and drafting skills as designs move from prototype to high-volume global production.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
AME is the scalability engine within AR Operations. We bridge innovation and execution by integrating DfX principles early in the engineering process. The team is currently supporting multiple NPI programs across next-generation robotic platforms, with significant growth in scope and complexity. This role is critical to maintaining our manufacturing readiness cadence as the portfolio expands.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- 8+ years of manufacturing engineering experience including new product introduction (NPI)
- Advanced proficiency in 3D CAD modeling (SolidWorks, Creo, or CATIA) and 2D technical drafting including GD&T application per ASME Y14.5
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent experience
- Demonstrated experience creating and interpreting complex production drawings and 3D models for electromechanical assemblies
- Broad manufacturing commodity background (Mechanical and Electrical)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, material science, physics or equivalent, or Master's degree
- Expert-level proficiency in SolidWorks or Creo with experience in model-based definition (MBD), surfacing, and large assembly management
- Experience creating tooling drawings, fixture designs, and manufacturing-intent 2D documentation packages for supplier release
- Experience with tolerance stack-up analysis tools (e.g., 3DCS, Sigmetrix, or manual RSS methods)
- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Deep commodity experience with one or more of the following: DC Gearmotors/encoders; Plastics (injection molding); Metals (Stamping, Machining); PCBAs; Sensors; Cables

title: Support Ops Manager II, FBA Support Operations
descriptionHtml:
WW Selling Partner Services (SPS) is focused on making Amazon the safest and most trusted company on earth for customers, brands, and selling partners and the best place to build a successful business. Within SPS, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service selling partners engage to make their items available to customers around the world who take advantage of Amazon Prime. FBA Support Operations is a critical bridge between Amazon’s product, technology, and fulfillment network teams and our selling partners. We currently serve the US, CA, EU, JP, AU, MX, and BR marketplaces, but our vision is to build a global team that follows the sun. Our work spans over 70 workstreams – from individualized coaching of selling partners, to resolving cases when something goes wrong in the inbound shipping and fulfillment processes, to identifying and correcting defects in selling partner shipments that can add cost and risk safety and customer experience.

We are looking for a results-oriented, customer-obsessed, data-driven leader who is passionate about innovating and optimizing across people, processes and technology to be a world-class support organization. The ideal candidate is an influential leader with a proven track record inspiring their team to deliver big results. They are able to continuously improve the operational efficiency of their team through good prioritization, and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate ambiguity. They have the capability and passion to foster a culture of innovation, inspiring their team to identify process and technology improvements that complement operational excellence to deliver increasingly better outcomes. They will index high on people development, and they believe at their core that leaders operate at all levels of an organization. The ideal candidate also demonstrates strong seller-facing communication leadership — they understand how to build trust-based advisory relationships with selling partners, coach their team to move beyond transactional interactions, and drive meaningful seller engagement that results in sustained behavioral change and defect elimination.

Operations: The candidate needs to be able to drive results in a production environment. Must lead their team and stakeholders towards meeting operational metrics of quality, productivity, and service levels. Will be responsible for setting the goals and vision for the function(s) operating under the candidate. This includes owning the end-to-end seller coaching lifecycle, ensuring the team delivers measurable account-level impact rather than transactional case resolution.

Stakeholder Management and Communication: The candidate would need to interact with multiple stakeholders within India and globally and at times, would be required to influence and drive consensus between teams. The candidate would also be required to write high impact, clear and concise documents (Support Strategies, Business review documents, etc.). Additionally, the candidate must be able to represent the seller coaching program's impact and insights to senior leadership, translating frontline seller engagement data into strategic narratives that inform program direction and investment decisions.

People Leadership: The candidate would be responsible for creating mechanisms for employee growth and development. This would mean enabling People Managers and creating succession plans. Will strike the right balance between effective delegation while maintain a connect with the team through different communication channels (1:1 connects, Huddles, Open office hours etc.). The candidate must develop their team's consultative communication skills — coaching specialists to adaptive insight-driven seller advisory dialogues that uncover root causes and build long-term seller trust.

Process Improvements, Automation, and Innovation: The candidate would need to drive innovation within the team, such that operational inefficiencies can be removed and existing procedures/SOPs be enhanced. Should be able to identify and lead projects across various teams, develop new metrics and drive creation of new tools for the same. The candidate should leverage seller engagement insights and frontline feedback to identify systemic defect patterns, propose scalable coaching interventions, and partner with DP&R and product teams to translate seller-facing observations into program-level improvements.

We value individual expression, respect different opinions, and work together to create a culture where each of us is able to contribute fully. Our unique backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our ability to achieve Amazon’s mission of being Earth’s most customer-centric company.


Key job responsibilities
• Responsible for the overall direction and performance of 15–20 Seller Outreach Specialists.

title: Operations & Logistics Internship, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

- Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement

- Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones

- Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.

- Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.

- Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.

- Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.

Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.

Opportunities:

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Kaiserslautern- Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Du bewirbst dich auf unseren Talent Pool für Logistikpraktika mit Start ab Januar 2027. Durch eine frühzeitige Bewerbung profitierst du von:

* Frühzeitiger Berücksichtigung für verfügbare Positionen
* Bevorzugtem Zugang zu gewünschten Standorten und Startdaten
* Größerer Flexibilität bei der Terminplanung im Interviewprozess

Unser vorläufiger Zeitplan: Interviews beginnen im September, das Role Matching startet voraussichtlich im Oktober. Dieser Zeitplan kann sich je nach geschäftlichem Bedarf ändern.

Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.
Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.

Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.


Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:
• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.


A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.
Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.
Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.


About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:
• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2027 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.
Internal job description

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

The Category Growth Manager must also be an effective communicator, working with some of Amazon Australia's most important partners and vendors, as well as with internal colleagues and cross-functional leaders. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a passion for retail and a high level of flexibility and commitment.
________________________________________________

There are also a great range of benefits that make Amazon a great place to work, including our popular Dogs At Work program which has been proven to lower stress and boost morale and is now running successfully in our corporate offices around Australia.

Our commuter benefits scheme allows employees to save on the cost of getting to and from work while Amazon also offers subsidized health insurance for employees and their dependents on top of salary continuance (income protection), and life insurance.

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location.

Key job responsibilities
To excel in this role, you will leverage:
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to earn trust and influence as well as to hold stakeholders, often more senior than you, accountable for high standards
- Learning-based problem-solving: breaking down issues into work streams, working backwards from key deadlines
- Advanced project management skills, with a strong sense of accountability for outcomes
- Enjoyment of analytical tasks – working to create different scenarios based on alternative solutions
- Comfort managing a wide variety of projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous business environment
- Willingness to "roll up your sleeves" and operate with limited guidance
- Strong commercial and people judgment
- Analytical ability to think both strategically and tactically

A day in the life
As a Category Growth Manager for our Books category, you'll spend your day balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving. You might start by analysing sales data to identify growth opportunities, then move into negotiations with publishing partners to secure exclusive titles or favorable terms. You'll collaborate with our marketing or operations teams to develop category initiatives, troubleshoot challenges as they arise, and present recommendations to senior leadership. Your work spans financial planning, vendor relationship management, and creative problem-solving—all while staying connected to what our customers want to read.

About the team
We're a collaborative group passionate about books and committed to making them accessible to everyone in Australia. Our team works across retail, vendor partnerships, and category strategy to continuously improve the customer experience. We value diverse perspectives and creative approaches to solving problems. As a Category Growth Manager, you'll be part of a supportive environment where your ideas matter, your contributions are visible, and you'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve our customers. We're excited about the potential to expand our Books category and grow our vendor partnerships in meaningful ways.

- 4+ years of retail, operations, product or program management, or business management/consulting with negotiations and delivering results experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience with financial analysis and P&L ownership

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
- Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development
- 3+ years of with Excel experience

title: Technical Program Manager III, IES Prime
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about building innovative technology solutions that drive Prime membership growth and deliver personalized experiences? Join our IES Prime team where you'll lead complex technical programs across multiple stakeholders to create differentiated customer journeys throughout the Prime lifecycle. In this role, you'll leverage your deep technical expertise in large-scale distributed systems to drive strategic initiatives that connect various Amazon systems, enhancing the end-to-end Prime experience for customers in Emerging Markets.

Working at the intersection of customer experience and technical implementation, you'll tackle challenges across distributed systems, customer-facing applications, high-throughput production environments, and the application of ML/AI to enhance the Prime membership journey. This unique position offers exceptional visibility across Amazon's ecosystem while contributing to Prime's north star vision of becoming Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program.


Key job responsibilities
1. Define and validate complex program requirements across multiple stakeholder teams, solving ambiguous problems and proactively identifying risks related to Prime lifecycle experiences
2. Partner with engineering teams to create high-level technical designs and architectural for implementing solutions that integrate with various Amazon systems, ensuring scalability and performance for high-volume customer experiences

You'll brainstorm solutions for scaling a personalized post-signup journey, then unblock your team by facilitating a design review with partner engineering teams. Afterward, you'll contribute to the team's architectural evolution during a technical review session, analyze program metrics, and prepare updates for leadership on the progress of your initiatives that improve Prime's value-for-money promise in price-sensitive markets.

Prime's north star vision is to be Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program, delivering profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience. Our mandate spans creating differentiated post-sign-up journeys, deepening benefit engagement, communicating value realized through personalized experiences, and enabling seamless renewals that reinforce Prime's value-for-money promise—a core differentiator in price-sensitive markets.

title: Indirect Tax Risk & Assurance Analyst, Intl Indirect Tax Controllership
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Indirect Tax Risk & Assurance Analyst to join our International Indirect Tax Controllership (IITXC) team. This team operates as a core component of the Second Line of Defense (2LOD) within Amazon's Tax Governance, Risk and Assurance (GRA) Program, providing independent oversight, periodic assurance testing, and residual risk reporting across Amazon's international indirect tax operations.
You will perform control testing, extracting and analysing data, in order to assess the strength of controls in place to manage Amazon's indirect tax risks. Following data analysis, you will draw conclusions on accuracy and control effectiveness, collaborating with other teams to agree findings and remediation actions required. Testing will be routine and adhoc and involve working on extremely large data sets, requiring use of tools and AI to maximise testing impact at scale.
The role covers all regions excluding North America, with a primary focus on International Stores (Retail and Marketplace), and is expected to expand to all business lines in the future. You will be expected to enhance testing programs and methodology where improvements can be made.
This is an individual contributor role requiring VAT/indirect tax experience, strong analytical skills, and the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, multi-jurisdictional environments.


Key job responsibilities
•Operate recurring operational and transactional data extraction as part of 2LoD risk evaluation.
•Data analysis and manipulation of extremely large data sets, utilizing data analytical tools wherever possible.
•Data interpretation against expected results of assurance testing and working with other teams to assess the impact of findings on the risk profile.
•Overseeing the completion of actions set to remediate issues found within assurance testing, including generating associated metrics for leadership.
•Propose and implement additional testing plans based on outcomes of testing.
•Identify opportunities to enhance controls, monitoring approaches, and operational risk practices.
•Leverage and develop tools and AI to improve efficiency and enable assurance activities at scale.
•Consult with Tax Planning experts on indirect tax impact of findings identified during testing.



A day in the life

Basic qualifications

- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Ability to analyze operational and transactional data to identify control gaps, weaknesses, or inconsistencies and formulate actionable risk mitigation recommendations.
- Strong interest in technology and AI; ability to work alongside technical colleagues on automated control design or GenAI-assisted assurance workflows.
- Experience operating in multi-jurisdictional environments within large organizations or commercial marketplaces with complex indirect tax obligations.
- Ability to communicate complex tax and risk findings clearly to both technical and non-technical (non-tax) audiences, including senior leadership.
- Experience working collaboratively and independently across functional boundaries with business operations, tax planning, tax compliance, internal audit, and risk/monitoring teams.
- Experience in large multinational business, with a significant portion in a VAT/GST planning, advisory, audit or assurance capacity, or 3+ years’ experience in global tax/law/accounting practice in indirect tax (VAT/GST) advisory or assurance.
- Good indirect tax awareness across multiple jurisdictions (focus on EU VAT legislation).

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with assurance, control frameworks, or operational risk management, enabling effective review and validation of testing methodologies, evidence, and controls.
- Master's degree (LL.M., M.Sc.) in Tax or Law; professional qualification such as CTA, ADIT, ACA, or ACCA.
- Familiarity with SOX/internal controls testing, COSO framework, or similar risk and control methodologies.
- Experience with e-commerce, digital marketplace, or platform business models and the associated indirect tax complexities.
- Exposure to customs duties, digital services taxes, or withholding tax on digital transactions.
- Experience presenting to VP/Director-level stakeholders or external regulators and auditors.
- Project management experience or formal PM methodology (PMP, PRINCE2); ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and deliver to deadlines.

title: Assistant.e RH, Human Resources
descriptionHtml:
*Il s'agit d'un contrat à durée déterminée de 8 mois.*

L’une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Amazon place la barre très haut en matière d’expérience client tient au fait que les RH veillent à ce que nous ayons la meilleure équipe derrière nous. Nous avons besoin d’une main-d’œuvre agile, afin d’avoir les bons talents en nombre suffisant pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients. En tant qu’assistant·e RH, vous aurez pour objectif de motiver nos collaborateurs·trices et de maintenir leur engagement en leur offrant une expérience enrichissante. En travaillant au sein d’une équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de partager des idées et d’apprendre des autres pour faire évoluer votre carrière.

Key job responsibilities
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les responsables RH et la direction sur des projets ayant un impact humain afin de créer un environnement de travail agréable
Traiter les questions quotidiennes ayant trait aux RH et aux questions administratives (intégration des nouvelles recrues, outils en libre-service, évaluations de l’assiduité, etc.)
Analyser les tableaux de bord internes afin de créer des rapports à l’intention des dirigeants de votre site
Planifier des initiatives visant à favoriser le bien-être et l’expérience des employé·es sur le site
Effectuer des audits pour garantir la conformité aux processus de l’entreprise, à la législation en matière de protection des données, au droit du travail local et aux meilleures pratiques RH

A day in the life
Vous n’occuperez pas une fonction de bureau conventionnelle, mais travaillerez sur site au contact de nos équipes d’entreposage. En fonction de votre lieu d’affectation, vous travaillerez peut-être en rotation avec vos collègues assistant·e·s RH. Cela signifie qu’un membre de l’équipe RH est toujours à proximité pour répondre aux interrogations du personnel.
Le rôle de l’assistant·e RH est très varié. En plus de nous aider à maîtriser les principaux processus RH, vous épaulerez les responsables de votre équipe dans différents projets visant à impliquer le personnel. Il peut s’agir de recueillir les commentaires des employé·es et d’organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux plans. Vous pourriez, par exemple, avoir à recueillir les commentaires des parties impliquées, organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux projets ou participer à la création d’un environnement inclusif dans lequel les employé·es se sentent à l’aise pour poser toutes leurs questions relatives aux ressources humaines.

About the team
Le service RH joue un rôle essentiel dans le fonctionnement de l’entreprise et la gestion des collaborateurs·trices. Baptisée « équipe PXT » (People Experience and Technology Solutions), elle veille avant tout à la mise en place d’un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour que l’innovation, la satisfaction client et l’agilité continuent de faire rayonner Amazon partout dans le monde.
Nous adoptons une approche holistique, proactive et intégrée de la gestion du personnel. Notre équipe a « l’obsession de la satisfaction client ». Elle s’attache à résoudre rapidement les problèmes d’implication et de motivation des employé·es, afin que rien n’affecte l’expérience globale des employé·es et des clients. En définitive, notre travail consiste à veiller à la conformité d’Amazon aux normes RH les plus strictes et à faire progresser la stratégie et les objectifs d’Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Connaissance de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Une expérience dans la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris avec vos pairs et la direction
- Parfaite maîtrise du Français, à l’écrit et à l’oral, l'Anglais est un plus.
- Une expérience significative dans le domaine des ressources humaines, des relations avec les employé·es ou de la paie

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans le traitement des processus de nouvelles recrues et des tâches administratives
- Connaissances de base du droit du travail et des pratiques en matière de RH et de paie

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. title: Sr Product Manager - Tech, ASP Strategy & Ops
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Senior Product Manager - Technical to define the product vision and strategy for the Migrations & Modernization analytics portfolio within AWS Specialist & Partner (ASP). As a strategic partner to Migrations & Modernization leadership, this role translates complex migration data into actionable products, drives reporting and AI strategy, and shapes the direction of data products that support migration program growth and revenue realization. The Sr. PM-T leads the end-to-end product lifecycle for the team's reporting, data, and AI-powered analytics products, developing and managing the roadmap to help field roles (Migration Advisors, CSMs, AMs, PSMs, PDMs, PCSMs, PMPs) increase program velocity and customer outcomes. Partners with stakeholder groups across Finance, GTM, Programs, and field teams to achieve operational excellence through product prioritization, adoption analytics, business reviews, and communicating product direction both verbally and in writing. As the analytics landscape evolves toward agentic AI, this role will be instrumental in shaping how the team builds and deploys AI-powered agents that augment field productivity and surface insights at the point of decision. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance product rigor with stakeholder partnership, translating data into product strategy while building trusted relationships across all levels of the organization.

A successful candidate is a strategic leader with strong technical and product instincts who understands end-to-end data product workflows (from data ingestion through dashboards and AI agents) and can make prioritization decisions across multiple stakeholder groups. They will possess strong verbal and written communication skills and thrive in fast-paced environments.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements across the team's reporting, data, and AI agent portfolio
Determine what to build, defer, and deprecate; translate stakeholder needs into prioritized product requirements
Partner closely with BIE leads to foster a collaborative, empowered culture focused on delivering customer value
Establish a shared vision across the organization by engaging with stakeholders and ensuring the roadmap meets customer and business needs
Create buy-in for the product vision, both internally and with cross-functional partners
Identify analytics that help field roles execute migrations and translate those into data products that serve each role's workflow
Own communication with leadership and cross-org partner teams

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Business Analyst , NCC- Hercules
descriptionHtml:
「お客様にとって本当に価値あるソリューションを、自分の手でつくりたい」― そんな想いを持つ方へ。
Amazon Customer ServiceのNCC- Herculesチームでは、世界中の多様なメンバーと連携しながら、グローバル規模で顧客体験の未来を切り拓く仲間を募集しています。
このポジションでは、課題の本質を見極める深い洞察力を活かし、データ可視化や分析を通じてビジネスに直結するソリューションを提供していただきます。ドメインやプロセスに関する専門性を磨きながら、ステークホルダーとの協働を通じて、組織全体にインパクトをもたらす。そんなやりがいのある環境がここにあります。
多角的な視点を持ち寄り、変革を推進するダイナミックなチームの一員として、あなたの力を発揮してみませんか？

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
• 業務全体の把握：チームが担当する各オペレーション（問い合わせ対応、エスカレーション処理、データ管理など）の流れや仕組みを理解し、全体像を把握する。
• 緊急案件のハンドリング：重大なシステム障害やお客様への影響が大きいインシデントが発生した際、関連チームと迅速に連携し、ビジネス・顧客・現場への影響を最小限に抑えるための対応をリードする。
• リスク軽減アクションの実行：社内ツールやシステムを活用し、問題の拡大を防ぐための具体的な対策（アカウント制御、フロー変更、一時対応など）を迅速に実施する。
• プロダクトチームとの連携：担当領域に関する課題やニーズをプロダクトチームに共有し、機能改善やシステム開発の優先順位について合意形成を図る。
• データの収集・整理・可視化：複数のデータベースやレポートから必要な情報を抽出・統合し、意思決定者がすぐに判断できるダッシュボードやレポートを作成する。
• 根本原因の分析と改善提案：繰り返し発生する問題やパフォーマンス低下の原因を特定し、データに基づいた改善策や新たなビジネス機会を提案する。

title: Risk Manager (Trade Analytics), Global Trade Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Trade Services (GTS) organization owns, develops, and implements global policies, standards, solutions, and best practices for cross-border compliance. We partner with business and operations stakeholders to integrate trade requirements into upstream processes as preventative controls, mitigating downstream compliance risk before it materializes.

We are seeking a Risk Manager with deep expertise in trade analytics, optimization, and trade instruments. You will quantify the business impact of evolving trade regulations and partner with teams to design operational frameworks that leverage trade mechanisms to reduce cost exposure while enabling their strategic objectives.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the impacts of new trade guidelines, tariff changes, and regulatory developments into concrete, quantifiable business impact to Amazon
- Develop end-to-end data traceability from sourcing through customs to fulfillment and financial reporting
- Design scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and trade-off evaluation frameworks to support strategic trade decisions; surface risks and opportunities to leadership with exposure assessments and recommendations
- Partner with business organizations to influence trade strategy and sourcing decisions

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience handling confidential information

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
- Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
- Experience with SQL and Excel
- Working knowledge of trade instruments and ability to distill regulatory developments (e.g., Section 301/232, AD/CVD, executive orders) into actionable recommendations for non-trade stakeholders
- Experience modeling the financial impact of trade policy shifts — landed cost, duty exposure, scenario analysis

title: WW Sr. BD, MSP Program, Worldwide Managed Services Provider Program
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a strategic business development leader for the AWS Managed Service Provider Program (MSP). AWS is the world's leading cloud provider with the most comprehensive and broadly adopted portfolio of cloud services and an innovative community of customers and partners. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—are using AWS to lower costs, become more agile, and innovate faster.

As a Business Developer for the MSP Program, you will define the strategic direction of how AWS engages with and grows the MSP partner ecosystem. You will identify market opportunities, shape the long-term vision for MSP partner collaboration, and influence cross-organizational strategy to drive measurable business outcomes. You will work directly with MSP partners to understand their evolving needs, co-develop growth strategies, and ensure AWS's MSP value proposition remains differentiated and compelling in a rapidly changing market.

This role has a global responsibility and you will influence and collaborate with a cross section of AWS leaders including solution architects, partner management, sales, technology, marketing, PR and executive leadership. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who can see around corners, operate at the intersection of business strategy and partner development, and translate bold ideas into scalable initiatives that deliver results. You bring strong executive presence, the ability to influence without authority, and a bias toward action in ambiguous environments. Being a data-driven, analytical decision maker with excellent written and oral communication skills, including public speaking, are key in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and drive the strategic vision for AWS's MSP partner ecosystem, identifying new market opportunities and shaping how AWS and MSP partners co-innovate and grow together
- Lead high-impact strategic initiatives from concept through execution — building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and delivering measurable partner and customer outcomes
- Engage directly with MSP partners at the executive level to understand their business models, identify growth levers, and co-develop joint strategies that accelerate mutual success
- Influence cross-functional AWS leadership (sales, technical, marketing, finance) to align investment and resources behind the MSP strategy
- Think Big — challenge the status quo, propose bold new approaches to partner engagement, and define what the next generation of MSP collaboration looks like
- Develop frameworks to evaluate strategic opportunities, prioritize bets, and measure the impact of initiatives on partner growth and AWS revenue

A day in the life
You start your day reviewing strategic progress against key initiatives — are partners adopting new programs, are joint go-to-market efforts driving pipeline? You engage directly with MSP partner executives to understand what's working, where friction exists, and what bold moves could unlock growth. You spend time crafting narratives that influence AWS leadership to invest in new strategic directions. You collaborate with cross-functional teams — not to manage their operations, but to align them around a shared vision and remove barriers to partner success. You end your day thinking about what's next: the whitespace in the market, the unmet partner needs, and the strategic bets that will define the MSP program's future.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

title: Praktikum im Bereich Logistik - Horn-bad Meinberg - Start 2027
descriptionHtml:
Bitte beachte: Wir haben verschiedene Möglichkeiten in ganz Deutschland und benötigen Flexibilität bezüglich der Standorte. Wenn du dich für die Stelle bewirbst, gib bitte alle deine bevorzugten Standorte in Deutschland an.
Alle unsere Praktika finden vollständig vor Ort statt.

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. In den Logistikzentren werden jährlich Millionen von Artikeln kommissioniert und verpackt, während die Zustellteams daran arbeiten, Bestellungen pünktlich an die Kund:innen zu bringen. Sicherheit hat oberste Priorität, und die Betriebskultur ist geprägt von Teamwork, Vielfalt und einer gemeinsamen Arbeitsethik, die das Geschäft reibungslos am Laufen hält. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:
• Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Praktikums kannst du für eine Absolvent:innen-Stelle oder ein zweites Praktikum in Betracht gezogen werden, was es dir ermöglicht, deine Reise mit Amazon fortzusetzen. Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.
Praktikums-Starttermine über das Jahr:
• Wir stellen Praktikant:innen ein, die jederzeit von Januar bis Juli 2026 anfangen können. Jeden Monat führen wir 1-2 Onboarding-Tage für neue Mitarbeiter:innen durch.

Basic qualifications

- Derzeit im vorletzten oder letzten Jahr und auf dem Weg zu einem Universitätsabschluss in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Ingenieurwesen oder einem anderen verwandten Bereich.
- Berechtigt, ein Vollzeit-Praktikum von 3-6 Monaten zu absolvieren.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch und der Landessprache des Landes, für das du dich bewirbst (Gemeinsamer Europäischer Referenzrahmen C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Starke Problemlösungs- und Analysefähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen und innovative Lösungen zu identifizieren.
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten, fähig zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
- Bewiesene Neugier, Proaktivität und Bereitschaft, Herausforderungen in einem unklaren, schnelllebigen Umfeld anzunehmen.

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

You will work across the team and its customers to align on a short and long-range supply plan. You will contribute to our Global Spare Planning function to understand the needs of our data centers across our network and manage the inventory across different nodes of our supply chain.

If you love being at the forefront of industry growth and development, developing and executing processes in a highly ambiguous environment, identifying information gaps and collaboration needs, and driving business strategy, then this is the spot for you. This is a high impact role offering an opportunity to drive and influence business-critical decisions impacting the long-term future of the business.

· Review buying multiples, minimums, replenished forecasts, lead-times, and vendor performance to optimize inventory performance.
· Partner and collaborate with business partners, suppliers, and operations proactively for the collaborative forecasting process to drive inventory optimization, part availability and cost productivity.
· Develop Strategies and mechanisms to monitor, reduce, and control inventory excess across regions and categories

A successfull candidate will need to:

title: Systems Development Engineer II, AWS Cross Domain Services (CDS)
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Cross Domain Services team is seeking a Systems Development Engineer who is passionate about operational excellence. This engineer will help to operate and scale the services that connect AWS regions of differing security requirements.

An Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) is a collection of AWS regions provided for a customer with specific security requirements. The AWS Cross Domain Services team provides solutions for customers to move data between regions with differing security requirements. We are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. AWS is building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world and the AWS Cross Domain Services team is essential to AWS’s dedicated cloud expansion. We need talented, adaptable engineers to help us implement and operate these complex systems.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Cross Domain Services team, you will:

- Have the opportunity to leverage the latest cloud computing technologies.
- Improve the availability of cross domain services to better serve U.S. Government agencies.
- Use your strong background in Linux, networking, and cloud services to raise our already high operational excellence bar.

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery - Controls
descriptionHtml:
As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.

Key job responsibilities
Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.

Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center.  Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.

Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.

Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.

Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.

Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers.  Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholders management.

Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.

Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.

Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.

Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.

Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.

Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We're looking for a Thermal Design Engineer who combines superb technical, research and analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right work done quickly and effectively. This person must have experience working in spacecraft design, producing top notch thermal analysis and providing essential thermal related input and recommendations to vehicle architects and subsystem leads.

Key job responsibilities
- Support extensive architectural trades by performing preliminary thermal analysis of spacecraft and subsystems for orbital operational conditions and vehicle control options.
- Perform conceptual through detailed thermal analysis of Bus and Payload subsystems, components, and mechanisms.
- Support thermal design activities for additional future programs as the Amazon Leo constellation evolves.
- Develop automated scripts enabling rapid analysis updates to accommodate design trades (power states, duty cycles, structural mapping).
