Our team builds and operates a globally distributed DNS resolution service that enables AWS customers to securely resolve internal and external DNS names across regions, networks, and hybrid environments. You will help ensure that DNS queries are resolved securely, reliably, and within milliseconds for enterprise customers running workloads across VPCs, on-prem, and edge locations.

As an SDE, This is a rare opportunity to build a new AWS service from its preview launch toward global scale. You will work across the entire stack—control plane, data plane, API surfaces, and deep integrations with AGA, EC2 Networking, DNS Firewall, and Route 53 core systems. You will also help drive the system architecture, spearhead best practices that enable a quality product, and help coach and develop junior engineers. A successful candidate will have an established background in engineering large scale networking software, great communication skills, and a motivation to achieve results in a fast paced environment.

At Amazon Web Services, we like to “work backwards”: start by understanding what customers need and using that to guide our software engineering. We’re looking for a software engineer who is experienced in listening to customers, synthesizing their needs, and rapidly iterating our services to quickly put features into customers’ hands. Our best ideas become even better when we get feedback from real customer use. The sooner we can get that feedback, the more quickly we can grow.

This position will be part of the Amazon Route 53 team. Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable Domain Name System (DNS) service offered by Amazon Web Services. We operate in over 50 locations worldwide and provide advanced functionality such as Private DNS, DNS Firewall, DNS resolver and integration with a plethora of AWS services. On top of that, we offer fast change propagation with a 100% availability SLA. Our service is quickly growing and we're expanding in multiple directions: adding new features and functionality to our DNS services, better traffic management, new AWS integrations, improving our health check capabilities, and expanding with new security services and routing space.

We work on deep, technical problems that span a variety of core topics in computer science ranging from databases to networking to distributed systems to numerical analysis to security. We are looking for a developer who will lead the team and who feels strongly not only about building good software but also about running that software in the real world.

Amazon in a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a typical day, software engineers might whip up a prototype to prove an idea, instrument code to report a new metric, talk with customers, code up a feature, or draft a proposal for a radical new idea.

title: Automation Engineer, Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering - IntlRME
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Amazon has several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day. We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as an Automation Engineer (AE). The focus of the AE role is to fault find, troubleshoot and improve controls solutions for automated material handling equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, scales, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) systems, and control cabinets. The AE will also provide training to the Engineering Technicians on device troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.




Key job responsibilities

- Be the site level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all controls systems and sensors within the building. Work in a hands-on manner to actively monitor, fault find and repair systems in order to provide a high level of equipment availability to internal customers.
- Train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.
- Work within the Global Controls network to enhance the capability to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers by means of troubleshooting and prioritizing.
- Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects coordinated by the Global Controls network.
- Work with Global Controls Engineering and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained.
- Work alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment.
- Support other sites in the Mexico network as required.
- Interpreting both mechanical and electrical drawings plus understanding and developing improvement strategies for code conforming.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience
- Experience in engineering and estimating material handling and storage systems
- Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in dealing with material handling, flow and capacity
- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software

title: Area Manager:in / Abteilungsleiter:in Logistik - Horn-Bad Meinberg, Fulfillment Center
descriptionHtml:
This role is based in Horn-Bad Meinberg.

Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
- Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.

In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- A degree
- Relevant experience in people management
- Relevant experience of communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Relevant experience in using data or anecdotal evidence to influence business decisions
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and local language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen techniques
- Experience working in another logistics environment
- Relevant experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.




Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:

Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.


Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.


About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Familiarity with multiple web browsers, data base searching and instant messenger tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Area Manager für Führungskräfte mit militärischem Hintergrund (m/w/d) - standortübergreifend
descriptionHtml:
Wir setzen alles daran, einen Standort in Ihrer bevorzugten Region zu finden — deutschlandweit. Sprechen Sie uns an, und wir prüfen gemeinsam die Möglichkeiten.

Amazon leistet Pionierarbeit.

Seit dem Start unserer Online-Plattform im Jahre 1995 haben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen immer wieder neu definiert.

“We actively seek leaders, who can Invent, think big, have a bias for action, and deliver results on behalf of our customers.'' – Jeff Bezos

Entscheidend für eine Führungsposition in unseren Logistikzentren ist die Fähigkeit ein Team zu führen, Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter zu motivieren und zu inspirieren, sich und dem Team ambitionierte und erreichbare Ziele zu setzen und diese Ziele dann zusammen umzusetzen. Viele Zeitsoldatinnen und -soldaten haben jahrelang solche wertvollen Erfahrungen gesammelt und Amazon bietet die Möglichkeit, diese Erfahrungen und das Wissen nun in der Wirtschaft einzubringen.

Das Military Recruiting Team von Amazon steht zur Verfügung, um die zahlreichen Möglichkeiten innerhalb von Amazon Operations zu erörtern.

Wir haben die gleichen Erwartungen an alle Führungskräfte, egal ob sie militärische Erfahrung haben oder nicht: Pionierarbeit für die Kundinnen und Kunden leisten und weiter daran arbeiten, Amazon zum kundenorientiertesten Unternehmen der Welt zu machen.

Area Manager/Shift Manager
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung in die Abläufe unseres Logistik-Zentrums übernimmst Du die Leitung einer unserer Hauptabteilungen.

Du bist verantwortlich für die Steuerung, Überwachung und Kontrolle der operativen Prozesse sowie für die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung von 80 bis 120 Mitarbeiter*innen. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich sowohl im Tagesgeschäft als auch in Projekten zur ständigen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse mit.

Wir bieten Dir ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit hervorragenden Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen, flachen Hierarchien, leistungsgerechter Vergütung zuzüglich beschränkter Mitarbeiteraktien (RSU), sowie ein motiviertes Team.

Basic qualifications

- Du hast einen Bachelorabschluss oder Equivalent, vorzugsweise im Bereich Logistik, BWL, VWL oder einen als gleichwertig anerkannten Abschluss (Logistikmeister, Fachwirt, Staatl. geprüfter Betriebswirt o.ä.)
- Du verfügst über erste Führungerfahrung in einer Teamleitungsfunktion, vorzugsweise in einem prozessbasierten Logistikbereich mit hoher Umschlaggeschwindigkeit
- Du hast bereits erfolgreich Verantwortung für eigene Projekte übernommen und diese unter Berücksichtigung der entsprechenden Zeit-, Umfangs-, Budget- und Qualitätsvorgaben abgeschlossen.
- Dich zeichnen sowohl ein guter Geschäftssinn als auch qualitatives Urteilsvermögen aus
- Du verfügst über eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz im Bereich Problemlösung und gute analytische Fähigkeiten.
- Du bist detailorientiert: Du bist in der Lage, dich mit technischen Einzelheiten zu beschäftigen, kannst Ursachenforschung betreiben und falls nötig Daten extrapolieren und verarbeiten.
- Du hast exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowohl in Deutsch als auch Englisch
- Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Die Arbeit in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld ist Dir vertraut.
- Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position z.B. in der verarbeitenden Industrie, dem Handel, der Produktion oder der Logistik
- Du hast Kenntnisse in Operational Excellence (Lean Management, Six Sigma).

title: Sr. Product Manager, B2B, Amazon Business
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Business (AB) Japan team is seeking a talented Sr. Product Manager to drive the development of small business customers. On “Amazon Business” is a new marketplace to meet the procurement needs of enterprises include every size – from small business to large multi-national organization, as well as institutional buyers like universities, schools and public offices. AB customers benefit from a range of business-tailored features such as Pay by Invoice, and reporting and analytics to gain visibility into how their business is spending. Enterprises can take advantage of exclusive pricing and quantity discounts. All of this is added to the selection, convenience and value customers expected from Amazon.

As a Sr. Product Manager, you will have the responsibility to identify opportunities, define strategies and growth roadmaps within a defined scope of work, to launch projects, initiatives and/or product features to drive more value to our customers and increase their engagement within AB. You will work closely with marketing managers, tech teams, vendors, and other internal teams in JP and other marketplaces to make more customers explore Amazon Business and purchase products.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

The ideal candidate will have a high degree of ownership and will experiment to achieve high standards. The person must be able to think creatively, deal with ambiguity, possess a strategic mindset, manage changing priorities, and work with a high degree of autonomy. The candidate will also need to develop an in-depth understanding of the business and champion the needs of AB Japan small business customers, in order to deliver sustainable growth both in revenue and profitability.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and lead the strategic initiatives for AB small business(companies) working together with partner teams within Japan and WW.
- Identify growth opportunities by investigating and analyzing the Japan B2B market and the needs of small business customers
- Actively identify strategic and tactical issues that impair the ability to meet strategic, financial, and product roadmap goals
- Deliver solutions to eliminate blockers for growth opportunities and issue resolution by working with partner teams
- Build strong internal relationships across Amazon including teams from other markets. Influence internal teams including other regions to deliver the right results for our business growth.

A day in the life
As a Sr. PM within AB Japan, you will start your day catching up with your WW peers, while reviewing your key metrics to prepare for your weekly/periodical business review meeting. You will engage in follow ups with your partner teams to assess the status of the upcoming initiatives and/or launches, while sometimes presenting a document to request support for an exciting growth opportunity. You will be running analyses, like your latest launch's post-mortem or a dive deep of a particular trend. Sometimes, you will also find yourself writing documents to update the AB Leadership.

About the team
Visit >> Business Introduction and Employee Interviews

Visit >> Amazon business intake cases

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Experience overseeing roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Advanced level of Japanese (able to negotiate externally, able to make presentations to management team)
- Intermediate level of English (able to attend internal meetings, able to negotiate internally)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience with data analysis and SQL
- 2+ years of B2B environment experience

title: Area Manager II, YEG1
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

A day in the life
As an Area Manager II at an Amazon fulfillment center, you'll act as a strategic leader overseeing upto 80 associates while driving department level operational improvements. You'll conduct planning sessions with your team, coaching them through operational challenges while developing their leadership capabilities. On a typical day, you'll partner cross-functionally with teams such as Quality, HR, and Safety to implement scalable process improvements that could impact 200+ associates across multiple workflows. You'll diagnose root causes of performance gaps using advanced analytics, facilitate alignment meetings with senior leadership on department-level goals, and make data-driven decisions that balance competing priorities. You would leverage your strategic thinking to review department-wide metrics, and plan initiatives that directly impact millions of customer orders while maintaining high levels of engagement, safety, quality, and productivity standards.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience in the management of large teams (50+ members)
- Experience with process improvements (Lean Six Sigma and/or Kaizen)
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field
- Experience in one or more of the following industries: shipping/logistics distribution centers, manufacturing environments, hospitality, healthcare, retail, and customer-facing / customer-service environments
- Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills

title: Analista de Compras , Site Procurement Operation
descriptionHtml:
A Amazon é a maior empresa de e-commerce do mundo e está em plena expansão no Brasil. Buscamos pessoas curiosas, apaixonadas por resolver problemas e que queiram construir algo grande. Se você combina pensamento analítico com atitude proativa, aqui é o seu lugar.

Como Analista de Compras, você será peça-chave na operação de diversas Estações (Delivery Stations), atuando como elo entre a área Global de Procurement e as lideranças dos sites.

Seu papel será garantir que as compras de insumos e serviços funcionem de forma eficiente, estratégica e alinhada aos padrões globais da Amazon — atendendo simultaneamente múltiplas unidades com diferentes necessidades operacionais.



Key job responsibilities
- Gerenciar o ciclo completo de compras (sourcing, negociação, PO, recebimento e pagamento) para múltiplas Estações.
- Ser o ponto focal de Procurement para os stakeholders locais, entendendo demandas e traduzindo-as em ações de compras;
- Garantir aderência às políticas globais de Procurement, atuando como guardião dos processos e compliance;
- Identificar oportunidades de consolidação de volume, padronização de itens e redução de custos entre sites;
- Colaborar com fornecedores para assegurar qualidade, prazos e condições comerciais competitivas;
- Suportar a abertura de novos sites, garantindo que a cadeia de suprimentos indiretos esteja pronta para o Day 1;
- Atuar na resolução de problemas operacionais relacionados a compras com senso de urgência e ownership.
- Monitorar a qualidade do serviço dos fornecedores de Facilities.

A day in the life
Your role combines strategic vendor management with practical operational oversight. You'll balance multiple priorities - from ensuring day-to-day facility services run smoothly to optimizing long-term procurement strategies.

- Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities
- Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business
- Procurement, purchasing, supply chain related work in a procurement organization experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Transportation Manager - APAC
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS APAC transportation team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Transportation Manager with a background in transport operations and and logistics to manage the day-to-day operations for one of the fastest-growing industries in the world. This is an exciting opportunity to join an agile and driven team while ensuring the highest standards of services and safety compliance.

An ideal candidate has a background in transportation operations, with excellent data-driven problem resolution skills. They should have experience in vendor management and process design and improvement projects. The role requires exceptional communication skills and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities
VENDOR MANAGEMENT
• Act as point of escalation for transportation vendor related issues
• Manage vendor operational excellence through data driven metrics
• Implement and execute transportation strategies that support short and long term goals

AUTOMATION ENHANCEMENT
• Influence internal technical teams to drive multi-system process changes
• Provide scalable solutions for continued growth
• Set project requirements and drive agendas across internal and external teams

A day in the life
In this role you will:
• Lead daily tactical communication with external vendors (Logistics Service Providers) and internal customers on operational and safety matters
• Work with multiple stakeholder teams to develop and implement new best practices
• Drive continuous improvement in the operational environment internally and externally
• Ensure compliance with standards and regulations across transportation operations

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Knowledge of supply chain management concepts - forecasting, planning, sourcing, optimization and logistics or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
- Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Experience developing tools, reports, process maps, scorecards, and data visualizations that improve upon those currently employed for understanding the business and making decisions

title: Sales Account Manager, Amazon, Out of Country Program

title: Security Program Manager, AWS Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Security Program Manager (SPM) bridges the gap between security design, construction, and operational readiness.

The Security Program Manager will own the end-to-end delivery and life cycle of critical physical security systems, including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Video surveillance systems, and associated infrastructure, across new builds, expansions, and upgrades. As we shift toward automated, fleet-scale operations, your technical acumen will be critical. Acting as a key link between design, construction, and operations, you will review technical plans, identify and mitigate risks, and coordinate cross-functional teams including construction partners, design engineers, network specialists, and external integrators to ensure security devices seamlessly connects with centrally managed software platforms.


We are looking for a proactive leader who thrives in ambiguity and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where the construction schedules are constantly evolving.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the key business partner working directly with service business partners and internal stakeholders (primarily infrastructure, physical security and operations teams).
- Collaborate with engineers, technicians, project managers, and Sr. Leaders to develop your programs.
- Drive process change and improvement across multiple business and program teams.
- Report ad hoc, weekly, and monthly program and operating metrics.
- Run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.
- Manage security system integration vendor contracts to deliver projects.
- Communicate the status of programs with customers, stakeholders and conduct program reviews.
- Must be willing to travel 15% of the time as required when launching new locations (Domestically and Internationally).

About the team
The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Basic qualifications

- Experienced in vendor management and procurement process, including the establishment of key performance indicators and service level agreement
- Fluency in Bahasa and English, with the competency to communicate effectively with both local and overseas stakeholders
- 5 years of experience in managing and delivering Physical Security System projects
- Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Video Surveillance Systems

Preferred qualifications

- BA/BS degree or higher in related field of architecture, engineering, or project management. PSP, CPP, PMP Certification will be an added advantage.
- Demonstrated ability to use AutoCad/Desk, BIM, Bluebeam
- Working knowledge of network fundamentals, system integration, IoT devices, or centrally managed security platforms.

title: Global Environmental Construction Program Lead, AWS Environmental
descriptionHtml:
For over 15 years, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud computing platform. What is cloud computing? Cloud computing is the on-demand delivery of IT resources over the Internet.
In 2019, Amazon announced The Climate Pledge, which includes our commitment to power our operations with 100% renewable energy by 2025, on the path to achieving net zero carbon across our businesses by 2040. To learn more about AWS, visit https://aws.amazon.com and https://sustainability.aboutamazon.com/environment/the-cloud.

The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team critical to enabling AWS's growth around the world. The team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS's global environmental programs — defining risk management systems, setting global policies and procedures, developing standards, tools, and metrics, and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable environmental strategies that support current and future business objectives.

The Global Construction Environmental Program Manager will own and scale the Construction Environmental Program (CEP) across all AWS data center projects worldwide. Built on ISO 14001 principles, the CEP transforms how environmental management works across global construction by establishing environmental performance standards during construction and enabling AWS to deliver consistent outcomes. This individual will set strategic direction, drive program development, and lead cross-regional execution from design phase through to handover, working extensively with senior stakeholders and business partners to ensure construction projects are managed effectively across the global portfolio.




Key job responsibilities
• Own and drive the global Construction Environmental Program, setting strategic direction, key deliverables, goals, and metrics across all AWS regions

• Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Environmental Minimum Requirements (EMR) framework, integrated into General Contractor agreements globally

• Lead regional CEP Program Managers in rolling out and maturing the program across their regions, ensuring consistency of environmental standards across all AWS owned and permitted sites

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) connects our customers and our shippers. We combine people, technology and products to deliver for our customers at the lowest possible cost. Surface Transportation is the conveyor belt to connect the entire Amazon supply chain. We are a technology company that executes transportation, and we get to do it all at a scale that nobody has ever seen!

We love what we do. We have an incredible team that works hard to change the industry. We are inventing new things each and every day. We rolled out technology in the last two years that rivals anything inside of the transportation space in the last 100 years. We are growing and getting to lead people every single day.

As our business grows, we are going to use the same technology and the same standard best practices to build and invent all over the world. If you are interested in growing something new and different, there is an opportunity to do it inside of this space.

Surface Transportation is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Financial Analyst to join its Finance team. This is an exciting opportunity to create and innovate on behalf of our customers and build the transportation experience of the future. This role will have heavy impact and high visibility to the long term strategy for the business, and it will require strong partnership with the Operations teams as well as Finance, Accounting and Technology. Experience with this team opens up amazing career opportunities across Amazon, such as senior roles supporting an impressive array of business areas, project management roles, and/or management opportunities locally, regionally, and globally.

It is not just a truck driving down the highway. If you like taking a larger scope identifying the most cost effective and safest way to deliver to our customer you will enjoy transportation. This entire system has to move like a symphony and it has to be orchestrated. It is an incredible math problem that we have to solve; we have to put statistics and financial models behind it; we have to put algorithms behind it, to work as a team to identify where there are gaps in the process, and solve these issues quickly. title: SDM, Mobile App Foundations - Quality and Release
descriptionHtml:
How would you like to impact hundreds of millions of customers around the world and empower hundreds of engineers to build and ship new features each and every day? Our org is responsible for creating the best shopping experience for customers wherever they go on their favorite Android and iOS devices. As the SDM for the Release & Quality team within the Mobile App Foundations organization, you will own the mechanisms that get high-quality mobile releases into customers' hands safely, predictably, and fast.

Amazon Shopping mobile engineers have a diverse range of skills and talents and we can't wait to harness your passion to make our team even stronger. We set and raise the bar on the mobile app shopping experience by building engineering frameworks, tools, and code used by thousands of developers across Amazon. The Release & Quality team is central to that bar: we own the release pipeline and quality enforcement that thousands of Amazon developers depend on to ship to the Amazon Shopping app. We think in terms of frameworks not features; stability, scaling, and performance over using technology to solve problems.

As SDM for Release & Quality, you will lead a team responsible for the end-to-end health of the mobile release process across iOS and Android.

Your charter includes:
- Owning the release cadence and publication decision mechanisms, and the operational excellence and automation that keep releases predictable and on schedule.
- Raising the quality bar through automated testing enforcement and building regression detection mechanisms.
- Instrumenting release health, including dial-up monitoring, so issues are caught early and decisions are data-driven.
- Reducing operational burden by identifying systemic gaps and investing in automation and tooling rather than one-off fixes.
- Partnering closely with TPMs, partner mobile teams, and app store operations to align priorities, resolve release blockers, and manage escalations.

About you: You are a technical leader looking to build and expand on your passion for mobile. You want to build durable mechanisms that make releasing software fully automated, safe, repeatable, and fast. You think about quality and release as an engineering system, not a checklist, and you insist on the highest standards while keeping the team unblocked and shipping. You are comfortable diving deep into release incidents and metrics to find root causes, and you hold a high bar for accuracy in the status and signals your team produces. You want to challenge yourself to solve complex problems at scale that have never been encountered anywhere else. You enjoy managing a team, helping engineers grow their skills, and you earn trust with partners by turning ambiguous, cross-team release problems into clear plans with owners and dates.

About us: We're going to change the way customers shop on mobile. Along the way, we're going to face challenging and interesting problems that no one else has seen. We'll leverage our camaraderie, diversity, and strong culture to break down walls to find solutions that challenge our original assumptions, make the hard decisions, and deliver a final product that's superior to the proposals we started with.

Have the passion to build and the drive to change how we ship mobile apps? Join us!

Key job responsibilities
- Lead a team to accelerate mobile app releases while insisting on the highest standard for quality
- Influence design and architecture by sharing your mobile application development expertise
- Participate in the full development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and software quality needs.
- Own the delivery of an entire piece of a system or mobile application, and serve as a technical lead on complex projects.
- Build software solutions where the problem is not well defined.
- Design and define the interaction between the solution components and other systems where applicable.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

title: Sr. Builder - Mobile (Sr. SDE), Ring
descriptionHtml:
Ring is redefining how millions of people interact with their homes every single day. As a Senior Builder on this feature team, you'll own and evolve some of the most foundational user experiences in the Ring app — the surfaces customers touch every time they open it, and the experiences other engineering teams build on top of. When you ship here, the impact compounds across the entire app.

This team also owns experiences that sit at the heart of Ring's security promise to customers — the kind of work where reliability, latency, and clarity aren't nice-to-haves, they're the product. We need senior engineers with deep iOS or Android expertise — ideally both, or equivalent depth in a cross-platform framework like React Native — who can navigate that bar and raise it.

This is also a role for someone who sees AI as a fundamental shift in how software is built, tested, shipped, and maintained. You'll champion AI-powered development practices on the team and influence how engineers across Ring apply them to feature work.


Key job responsibilities
You will:

• Lead the technical design and delivery of foundational user experiences that millions of customers use every day, and that other Ring teams build their features on top of
• Own the architecture, quality, and long-term health of the surfaces this team is responsible for — making decisions that balance velocity, reliability, and scale
• Champion AI-powered development practices on the team — code generation, automated testing, intelligent code review, AI-assisted debugging — and help raise the bar for how the broader org applies them
• Set the bar for performance, reliability, and craft on experiences where customers expect responsiveness and trust at all times
• Partner closely with product, UX, backend, and platform teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences across Ring's connected device ecosystem
• Mentor and grow the engineers around you — through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and technical leadership
• Drive operational excellence: observability, on-call response, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of CI/CD and testing for your surfaces


A day in the life
As a Senior Builder on this team, you will:

• Shape the technical direction of experiences that anchor the Ring app and that other teams depend on — your decisions ripple far beyond your own surface area
• Tackle hard problems at the intersection of UX, performance, and reliability for features that customers rely on for their sense of safety
• Operationalize AI-powered workflows in your own development and across the team, identifying where AI can eliminate toil and accelerate delivery
• Engage in deep technical discussions about architecture, state management, navigation models, and platform-specific tradeoffs with experienced mobile engineers
• Build features and infrastructure that protect millions of homes — your work has real, tangible impact on people's sense of safety and connection


About the team
This team owns foundational user experiences that anchor the Ring app and that many other teams build features into. We hold ourselves to a high bar because the experiences we own are the ones customers see most often and rely on most heavily — including the moments when Ring's security promise is on the line.

You'll work closely with senior leadership every day. Ring is intentionally structured to break down the corporate org-chart barriers that slow teams down — builders sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the leaders setting direction, and decisions happen in the room rather than three layers up. That leadership is deeply hands-on, actively reshaping how we think about AI in software development, and shaped by a vision that has redefined what neighborhood safety looks like for communities around the world. As a Senior Builder, you won't just receive that vision — you'll help carry it forward into how Ring builds mobile software.

We combine the ambition and speed of a startup with the scale, resources, and impact of Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 7+ years of professional software development experience building mobile applications
- 5+ years of deep native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) or Android (Kotlin/Java) development, with working knowledge of the other platform — or equivalent depth building production mobile apps with React Native or a comparable cross-platform framework, with strong familiarity with at least one underlying native platform
- Demonstrated experience shipping and operating features at large scale (millions of daily active users)
- Experience designing and implementing modern mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, unidirectional data flow) using current platform tooling (SwiftUI/UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Combine, etc.)
- Strong command of the full mobile SDLC including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and production monitoring

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Demonstrated adoption of AI-powered development tools and practices (AI-assisted coding, automated test generation, intelligent code review, AI-driven debugging)
- Experience building features or surfaces that other teams integrate into or extend
- Experience working on user experiences with strict reliability, latency, or correctness requirements
- Experience with modern navigation, state management, and complex UI composition at scale
- Experience integrating cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform) into existing native applications
- Performance optimization experience for resource-constrained environments (battery, memory, network)
- Experience with REST APIs, real-time/event-driven services, or push-based architectures

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. title: Software Development Manager, AWS OpenSearch
descriptionHtml:
Amazon OpenSearch is a fully managed and Serverless service that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch clusters for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, and more. As part of AWS, we serve hundreds of thousands of customers who rely on OpenSearch to power mission-critical search and observability workloads at scale.

The Amazon OpenSearch Core Foundation team owns the foundational indexing and search systems powering both OpenSearch Managed Service and Serverless offerings. We are building next-generation systems that support multiple data formats, diverse execution engines, and federated queries across heterogeneous data sources. As Software Development Manager, you will lead the team responsible for developing OpenSearch's next-generation indexing systems — delivering best-in-class price-performance for search and analytics workloads. You will drive the technical vision and execution for systems that serve both managed and Serverless customers at scale, shaping how millions of users index, store, and query their data.


Key job responsibilities
* Lead and grow an organization of senior engineers focused on OpenSearch Core Foundation Indexing system, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and customer obsession.
* Define and execute technical roadmaps for OpenSearch Indexing systems, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term architectural investments.
* Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed Indexing systems, consistency models, and cross-region index replication.
* Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact.
* Establish operational excellence standards for the OpenSearch Indexing systems, including availability, latency, and durability targets, and lead the team in meeting and exceeding those targets.
* Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent; build a diverse, high-performing organization with a strong pipeline of future leaders.
* Collaborate across OpenSearch and AWS with peer SDMs and Directors to align on shared infrastructure, resolve cross-team dependencies.
* Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to senior leadership.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Security Software Development Manager, Operational Research, AWS Security
descriptionHtml:
We are building the platforms that power machine-speed security incident response across the world's largest cloud provider. Our automation investigates and remediates security events with minimal human intervention, from initial triage through eradication. We need a Software Development Manager to own the engineering backbone that makes this possible.

Amazon Security's Operational Research and Development team combines Security Engineers and Software Development Engineers in a single mission: reduce time-to-resolution for security incidents through automation at every stage of the response lifecycle. The SDM will own the platform portfolio that underpins all of our automation capabilities: the workflow orchestration engine, the enrichment API layer, the knowledge graph infrastructure, and the operational tooling that keeps them running in production.

In addition to the automation platform, you will be responsible for operating a broader AWS Security tools portfolio in the European Sovereign Cloud region, ensuring availability and compliance for services that require partition-eligible engineering staff.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Manager, you will:
- Lead and grow a team of Software Development Engineers responsible for the core platforms our security automation runs on
- Own the technical direction, operational excellence, and delivery roadmap for multiple production services (workflow engine, API gateway, data infrastructure)
- Partner daily with a Security Engineering manager who owns the security domain expertise and incident response capabilities, ensuring SDEs and SecEngs collaborate as embedded squads rather than separate silos
- Drive architectural decisions that balance rapid capability delivery with long-term platform reliability at scale
- Ensure operational readiness and support for security services deployed in the European Sovereign Cloud
- Hire, develop, and retain strong engineers: set clear growth paths, run rigorous code reviews, and build a culture of ownership where engineers ship what they build and fix what they break
- Own an on-call rotation focused on platform health and availability

About the team
The Operational Research team sits within AWS Security. We are a mixed team of Security Engineers and Software Development Engineers who share a single mission: make security incident response so fast and accurate that human involvement is reduced to the decisions that genuinely require judgment.

Our engineers own what they build. Each person carries meaningful end-to-end ownership of production systems, from design through deployment and operational excellence. We prototype rapidly, ship iteratively, and treat every manual step in our response pipelines as a problem to solve permanently.

The team values directness, intellectual honesty, and a bias toward building over discussing. We maintain a flexible, distributed working culture and core collaboration hours that respect personal time.

We are intentional about building an inclusive environment where diverse backgrounds and perspectives drive better security outcomes. Whether your path to engineering management was traditional or not, what matters is your ability to grow engineers, ship reliable platforms, and partner effectively across disciplines.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing and growing a team of software development engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development
- Experience in software development with at least one programming language (Python, Java, or TypeScript)
- Experience owning and operating production services with on-call responsibilities
- Experience defining technical roadmaps, prioritizing engineering work, and delivering against deadlines with a team
- Experience partnering across disciplines (security, operations, product) to align engineering work with business outcomes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a security operations or incident response environment, either building tooling for responders or managing engineers who do
- Experience with event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration systems, or data pipeline infrastructure at scale
- Experience with AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, ECS, or similar) in a production context
- Experience managing engineers across multiple production services simultaneously, balancing reliability with feature velocity
- Experience operating services in regulated or restricted environments (sovereign cloud, FedRAMP, or equivalent partition-awareness)
- Experience prototyping rapidly with LLM-assisted or AI-augmented development workflows
