title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Flight Software Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

About the Role:

We are looking for an Embedded Software Development Engineer to build and scale - VirtSat (Leo's Virtual Satellite Simulation platform). VirtSat enables developers and pipelines across Leo to create, provision, and test virtual satellites, ground gateways, customer terminals, and TT&C antennas on EC2 bare-metal infrastructure running KVM/QEMU.

As part of role, you will own the Graviton virtualization layer, managing VM lifecycle, LRU boot, subsystem provisioning, and software deployment for every virtual entity in the constellation. You will work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, embedded Linux, and satellite operations building the platform that every Leo satellite software release is tested on before launch.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Work On :

* Own the Graviton bare-metal virtualization layer — KVM/QEMU VM management, subsystem start/stop, health monitoring, and fault recovery.
* Develop embedded software in Rust, C, C++, or other modern languages for the virtualization and emulation layer
* Write device drivers and system applications for the various satellite systems running on virtual hardware
* Write software to interact with micro-controllers and emulated hardware peripherals (FPGA, HSM, sensors)
* Build and maintain the custom AMI pipeline that pre-configures all satellite dependencies, reducing provisioning time and preventing dependency drift
* Develop and optimize provisioning scripts that deploy satellite software (LEP images, firmware, certificates) onto emulated LRUs via SSM
* Implement plugin framework extensions for new LRU types (satellites, GGMAs, GTMAs, customer terminals) on the Graviton host
* Build network virtualization between VMs — WireGuard tunnels, inter-entity networking, and TT&C link emulation
* Optimize boot-time and provisioning latency for QEMU-based satellite instances
* Debug and resolve issues at the intersection of host OS (Ubuntu/ARM64), guest OS (LEP/Yocto), and QEMU emulation
* Develop fidelity improvements — HSM crypto emulation, EFUSE emulation, CAN bus simulation, and error injection frameworks
* Work closely with other software and hardware teams to support board bring-up and integration testing

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Experience in automation via Bash/shell scripting and Perl/Python programming
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
- Experience with Linux systems programming (C, Rust, Python, or Bash)
- Experience with virtualization or emulation (KVM, QEMU, Docker, or similar)
- Familiarity with embedded Linux (boot process, systemd, device drivers, or Yocto/Buildroot)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with ARM64 architecture or Graviton instances
- Experience with QEMU device emulation, QMP protocol, or custom QEMU plugins
- Experience writing device drivers or interacting with micro-controllers
- Experience with network virtualization (WireGuard, bridge networking, TAP/TUN interfaces)
- Familiarity with satellite systems, hardware test environments, or simulation platforms
- Experience with EC2 bare-metal instances and SSM for remote commanding
- Experience with AMI/image building pipelines (EC2 Image Builder, Packer)
- Familiarity with certificate provisioning, secure boot, or HSM interfaces
- Experience with Python packaging (pip, virtualenv) and container image management (ECR, Docker)
- Experience with Rust for systems programming

You should be comfortable with a high degree of
ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along

initiatives

Manage vendor relationships through procurement, testing, and installation of new and modified

As the Environmental test Manager of the SSL Engineering team, you will balance people

descriptionHtml:
How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
Technical writing to support change management program
Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
Role may support more than one location/site.




A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Annapurna ML
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs was a startup company acquired by Amazon in 2015, and is now fully integrated. If Amazon is an infrastructure company, then think Annapurna Labs as the infrastructure provider of Amazon. Our org covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. Amazon Nitro, ENA, EFA, Graviton and F1 EC2 Instances, Amazon Neuron, Inferentia and Trainium ML Accelerators, and in storage with scalable NVMe, are some of the products we have delivered, over the last few years.

Amazon Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of Amazon innovation. The Inferentia chip delivers best-in-class ML inference performance at the lowest cost in cloud. Trainium will deliver the best-in-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the Amazon Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, runtime and natively integrates into popular ML frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow and JAX. Amazon Neuron and Inferentia are used at scale with customers like Anthropic, Apple, various internal Amazon teams and more customers in various other segments.

In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with our Neuron software development team and strategic customers on accelerated Machine Learning solutions. You will bring your hands-on experience developing and deploying Deep Learning models and integrate it with our ML accelerator products, into large-scalable production applications.

You will need to be technically capable and credible in your own right, to become a trusted advisor for customers developing, deploying and scaling Deep Learning applications on Amazon ML accelerators. You’ll succeed in this position if you enjoy capturing and sharing best practices and insights, and help shape how Amazon ML accelerator technology gets used. You will be a hands-on partner to Amazon services teams, technical field communities, sales, marketing, business development, and professional services, to drive adoption. You’ll leverage your communications skills, and be very technical when doing so, to help amplify the thought-leadership around Amazon Neuron technology stack to the broader Amazon field community, as well as our customers.

Key job responsibilities

- Develop strong partnership with engineering organizations, serving as the customer advocate, to help drive product roadmap working backwards from customers feedback.
- Drive thought leadership by crafting and delivering compelling audience-specific messaging artifacts (product videos, demos, workshops, how to guides etc.) presenting Amazon ML accelerator technology through Amazon Blogs, reference architectures and solutions, and public-speaking events.
- Capture, implement and share best-practices knowledge among the Amazon technical community regarding Amazon ML Accelerators.

About the team
The Amazon Annapurna Labs team is a responsible for building innovation in silicon and software for Amazon customers. We are at the forefront of innovation by combining cloud scale with the world’s most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software and operations. Because of our teams breadth of talent, we have been able to improve Amazon cloud infrastructure in networking and security with products such as Amazon Nitro, Enhanced Network Adapter (ENA), and Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA), in compute with Amazon Graviton and the EC2 F1 FPGA instances, in storage with scalable NVMe, and now in AI and Machine Learning with Amazon Neuron SDK, Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators.

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.

In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager (Israel), EMEA Startups
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to support some of the most ambitious technology startups in one of the world's most innovative ecosystems? Join our EMEA Startups team in Tel Aviv helping high-growth Israeli companies maximize the value of AWS as they scale globally.

Israel's startup scene produces a disproportionate share of breakthrough technology companies. Founders here build AI-first products, fintech infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity solutions, and data-intensive systems that reach global scale fast. These companies need a cloud partner who understands both the urgency of startup life and the technical rigor required to build systems that hold up at scale.

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) in AWS Enterprise Support you will serve as the primary technical advisor and voice of the customer for a portfolio of fast-growing Israeli startups. You will play a crucial role in fostering their innovative and transformative work across AI/ML compute (including accelerated and GPU workloads) containers networking storage databases serverless security and more. It's an opportunity to work closely with technical founders and engineering leaders helping them make the right architectural decisions at each stage of their growth journey.

Enterprise support for startups is different from traditional enterprise engagement. It's an evolutionary approach: you start with deep technical guidance during early growth stages then adapt as the company matures and their needs become more strategic. You will help prioritize engineering efforts that tie directly to product launches investor milestones and market validation striking the balance between speed cost control and production readiness that defines the startup context.

As well as spending time working directly with customers you'll get time to sharpen the saw and keep your skills fresh. AWS has more than 200 services across a wide range of categories and it's important that we help startups take advantage of the right ones at the right time. You will act as a customer advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products and features for the startups you work with. This role also provides opportunities to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content presenting at events and contributing to the wider TAM and startup community.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical advisor for your startup customers building trusted-advisor relationships with CTOs VP Engineering and founding teams
• Engage across the full customer organization from individual engineers through to C-suite adapting your communication to each audience
• Help accelerate customer growth by crafting strategies that balance startup velocity with Well-Architected best practices across AI/ML compute containers and data infrastructure
• Conduct architecture reviews operational assessments and proactive risk identification. Analyze service events and operational patterns to drive continuous improvement in resilience performance and cost efficiency
• Drive technical discussions with founding teams on architecture trade-offs incident response and risk management as their systems scale
• Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops enablement sessions and brown bag sessions tailored to their technical needs
• Champion and advocate for your customers by connecting their feedback to AWS engineering teams influencing platform evolution and ensuring rapid resolution of concerns
• Collaborate with Solutions Architects Business Developers Professional Services and Account Managers to deliver coordinated customer value
• Develop and share technical content such as blog posts reference architectures and reusable solutions that help startups solve common challenges and reduce time-to-market

Key job responsibilities
- Act as the primary technical advisor for your startup customers, building trusted-advisor relationships with CTOs, VP Engineering, and founding teams
- Engage across the full customer organization, from individual engineers through to C-suite, adapting your communication to each audience
- Help accelerate customer growth by crafting strategies that balance startup velocity with Well-Architected best practices across AI/ML, compute, containers, and data infrastructure
- Conduct architecture reviews, operational assessments, and proactive risk identification. Analyze service events and operational patterns to drive continuous improvement in resilience, performance, and cost efficiency
- Drive technical discussions with founding teams on architecture trade-offs, incident response, and risk management as their systems scale
- Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, enablement sessions, and brown bag sessions tailored to their technical needs
- Champion and advocate for your customers by connecting their feedback to AWS engineering teams, influencing platform evolution, and ensuring rapid resolution of concerns
- Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services, and Account Managers to deliver coordinated customer value
- Develop and share technical content such as blog posts, reference architectures, and reusable solutions that help startups solve common challenges and reduce time-to-market

A day in the life
See what the team say about their roles:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ycFclUrpzKQ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M7j83fWoqmQ One morning you're reviewing a customer's inference architecture ahead of a product launch helping them hit latency targets. After lunch you're running a cost deep-dive on a container environment that has grown faster than expected and presenting a right-sizing plan to their CTO. The next day you're on a call with an AWS service team championing a feature request that your customers need. Later in the week you're preparing a strategic business review showing the quantified impact of your recommendations or you're at a customer's Tel Aviv office whiteboarding their disaster recovery strategy before they expand to a second region.

The work is varied technically deep and tied directly to customer business outcomes. You will also contribute to the broader TAM community by mentoring peers developing reusable technical content and sharing patterns across the team.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in technical roles involving distributed systems, cloud architecture, software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, Data & Analytics, or AI / ML.
- Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as technical account manager, solutions architect, consultant, or support engineer
- Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for a combination of the following: compute, storage, networking, databases, AI/ML, containers, DevOps, big data and analytics, security
- Demonstrated ability to drive technical discussions and communicate effectively with both engineering teams and executive stakeholders
- Experience working in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm
- Fluent in English and Hebrew

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent

title: System Manufacturing Integration Lead Engineer, Nitro Team, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs Hardware Engineering department is a fast growing and leading-edge research and development team that creates compute, storage server and machine-learning designs for our innovative web service and e-commerce technology platforms. Our designs are industry-leading in terms of performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the hundreds of thousands of customers who use utility computing today.

Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is looking for a Nitro System Manufacturing Integration Lead Engineer to be part of defining, shaping, and implementing manufacturing flows, test definitions, and card-to-server integration processes for Nitro-based platforms. This includes to be part of the manufacturing flow architecture, production test strategy, process stabilization, and yield optimization bridging system design intent with high-volume manufacturing execution.

Key job responsibilities
As a System Manufacturing Integration Lead Engineer, in the Nitro team, you will own the end-to-end manufacturing flows for accelerator card-to-server integration across manufacturing partner facilities driving the process from initial definition through stabilization into a scalable, high-yield mass production operation.

Key responsibilities include:
- Architect manufacturing flows — be part of the complete card-to-server integration sequence, including every process step, quality gate, and decision point from sub-assembly through system integration and tests.
- Define test strategy — be part of determining what to test, when, and at which station, covering card-level functional tests, post-integration validation, firmware provisioning, and first power-up diagnostics.
- Establish classification criteria — be part of determining pass/fail thresholds and test exit gates to maximize yield and minimize material waste.
- Drive process stabilization — work directly and on-site with manufacturing partners to implement, debug, and iterate on manufacturing flows from early builds through a locked, repeatable production process.
- Design alternative flows — develop parallel manufacturing paths to address real-world constraints such as component availability gaps, deferred card integration, and hub-based assembly models.
- Own process documentation & KPIs — maintain manufacturing flow baselines, drive process change control, and track yield, first-pass rate, cycle time, and defect Pareto.
- Lead cross-functional coordination — serve as the single point of ownership across hardware engineering, firmware, test/vetting, thermal, mechanical, and operations teams for Nitro-based accelerator servers built at scale.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering / SW Science / Compute engineering or in related field.
- 7+ years in system integration (HW/SW/SoC’s) and manufacturing for Compute/Embedded systems (ARM, x86, AMD).
- 3+ years working directly with design and manufacturing partners, including on-site presence at partner facilities.
- Experience leading a product through the full manufacturing lifecycle from initial flow definition through process stabilization and volume production.
- Experience with operating systems, boot loaders, networking, and remote debugging.

Preferred qualifications

- SW development experience including data analysis and database querying.
- Developing AI automation tools for testing, debugging, analysis, and code generation.
- Familiarity with statistical process and process capability assessment (Cp/Cpk).
- Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (DDR, PCIe, Ethernet) and protocols.
- Familiarity with server architecture, design, and integration in leading industrial companies.

title: Senior Product Design Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering - Electrical Products and Services (DCE-EPS)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is hiring a Senior Product Design Electrical Engineer with diesel generator experience for our Electrical Products and Services team. The Electrical Products and Services Team is a AWS's Data Center Engineering global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation for products used within our rapidly expanding data center footprint.

The Electrical Products and Services team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. We drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to Senior Leadership. We seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, you can design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast-paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a natural leader, smart and worked with high performing team of engineers that enjoys working with complex problems we want you! At Amazon, you will be responsible for working on product designs and supporting our wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

At Amazon, teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a product engineer at Amazon, you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including engineering service providers, manufacturers, vendors, inspectors, third party testing labs and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but shouldn’t be more than 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be necessary. Your contribution could consist of leading international projects and could require developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary.



Key job responsibilities

• Work with internal partner teams to solicit customer input and define design requirements for product design.
• Lead new product design, development and qualification of critical electrical power distribution equipment for AWS data centers with primary focus on backup power generation, specifically diesel generators, enclosures, and aftertreatment systems, as well as connecting dependencies with other electrical equipment.
• Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate equipment and components, ensuring tier 2-3 supply chain resiliency.
• Ensure compliance with UL, CSA, IEC and federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries through appropriate levels of testing.
• Validate design through prototype, pre-production and first-of-kind builds, conducting DFx and value engineering analysis through each step and updating design and documentation.
• Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical products.
• Ability to provide support for manufacturing activities for the new products on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
• Be a leader within the product development team as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.


About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
- Professional Engineering or Architectural License
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

- Experience in collaborating across Procurement and Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Commissioning, and suppliers on Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA), and Design for Serviceability (DFS), and/or value engineering

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Enterprise Security Products team within AWS operates like a startup to solve the hardest problems in enterprise security. We are building AI-powered products that help enterprise security teams understand, protect, and defend their infrastructure across multi-cloud environments. AI is not a buzzword here. descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to train and onboard new team members

title: Senior Category Manager
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Australia's Retail team is looking for a Senior Category Manager to join us as we continue growing and setting new standards in e-commerce for Australian customers. If you're passionate about delivering results, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact on how Australians shop, this role could be perfect for you.

This is a strategic, hands-on role requiring deep commercial acumen, full P and L ownership, and the ability to drive analysis that directly impacts business performance. A critical aspect is leading complex commercial negotiations with key vendors and strategic partners - structuring deals that drive mutual growth while balancing short-term targets with long-term partnership value. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, finance, supply chain teams, and brand partners to drive category growth. As an individual contributor, you'll deliver results through influence, mentor team members, and act as a Subject Matter Expert across the organisation.

title: Tax Governance Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Tax Governance Risk Manager to join the TAC team and help build and run the governance function for Amazon's worldwide tax compliance programmes. This is a small, high-impact team where everyone contributes to shaping how governance works, not just executing it.

Your primary focus will be operational: making the Holistic Tax Governance Framework work in practice across 100+ tax regulations. You will run governance cadences, maintain control inventories, track risk indicators, produce audit-ready documentation, and hold teams accountable. You will also work closely with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are embedded in product design and that changes to tax products do not introduce compliance gaps.

You will work within Amazon's Three Lines of Defence (3LoD) model, ensuring 1st Line controls are documented, tested, and effective while coordinating with 2nd and 3rd Line partners on assurance activities.

Key job responsibilities
Governance Execution
- Provide programmatic support and maintain effective tracking mechanisms for various governance mechanisms across various Tax programs (weekly, monthly, quarterly), ensuring they stay on schedule and produce the required outputs.
- Maintain the control inventory across worldwide tax programmes. Ensure controls are documented, have clear owners, and link to regulatory requirements.
- Track completion of Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and escalate when teams miss deadlines or fall below the required standard.
- Monitor governance actions and remediation plans to deadline. Chase overdue items.
- Contribute to integrating bad actor detection and prevention into the governance lifecycle.

Product Governance
- Work with product and technology teams to ensure governance requirements are reflected in product design, business requirement documents (BRDs), and implementation plans.
- Review product changes and new tax programme launches from a governance perspective, ensuring compliance checkpoints are embedded from the outset.
- Track governance-related product risks and open items, coordinating with programme managers to drive resolution.

Control Monitoring and Risk Tracking
- Review and challenge Monitoring Control Indicators (MCIs), identify adverse trends, and flag them for review.
- Support periodic control testing: prepare test plans, gather evidence, document results, follow up on remediation.
- Review and track issue register items to ensure timely closure and ensuring deviations are promptly escalated through established protocols.

Reporting and Audit Readiness
- Produce governance reports, dashboards, and status updates for governance forums and senior leadership reviews.
- Maintain audit-ready documentation with complete, version-controlled evidence trails.
- Track key governance metrics: RCSA completion rates, control effectiveness, issue closure velocity, regulatory submission accuracy.
- Support audit preparation and response, coordinating with Internal Audit and external regulators as needed.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Coordinate across Tax, Legal, Policy, Product, Technology, and Fraud Prevention teams to collect governance inputs and ensure deadlines are met.
- Act as the operational point of contact for governance queries from partner teams.
- Work across time zones with teams in the US, EU, Japan, and India.

A day in the life
Morning: you review the governance tracker. Two RCSAs are overdue. You send reminders and note the escalation path. Mid-morning: you join a working session with the Monitoring team to review MCI trends for a high-risk programme. One indicator is moving in the wrong direction. You document the finding and draft the agenda item for the next Quarterly Governance Review.
Afternoon: you review a BRD for a new tax regulation launch with the product team, checking that governance checkpoints and control requirements are baked in. You then update the control inventory, map the new controls, assign owners, and schedule the initial RCSA. Before close, you pull together the weekly governance status report and flag two items that need senior attention.
The rhythm is consistent: track, monitor, chase, document, escalate, report.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.

No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
- • 3+ years in risk management, compliance, audit, or governance.
- • Experience maintaining risk registers, control inventories, or RCSA processes.
- • Experience producing governance reports and audit-ready documentation.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience supporting the implementation of controls or contributing to audits over financial reporting environments
- Experience with financial services, payments or e-commerce
- • Experience with the Three Lines of Defence (3LoD) governance model.
- • Experience working with product or technology teams on compliance requirements.
- • Experience with control testing methodologies.
- • Familiarity with fraud detection or bad actor prevention frameworks.
- • Professional certifications (CIA, CISA, CAMS, or equivalent).
- • Comfortable working across multiple time zones with distributed teams.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within the operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within operational data centers around the globe. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.

We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data center facilities. The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. title: Sr. Finance Manager, Amazon Leo Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit satellite network, delivering fast, affordable broadband to enterprise and consumer customers globally. This is one of the most ambitious infrastructure programs in Amazon's history — combining satellite manufacturing, silicon development, global supply chain, terrestrial infrastructure, and enterprise technology at unprecedented scale. Leo Infrastructure Finance is at the center of it all.

The successful candidate will have effective analytical and communication skills, with an ability to build and articulate financial results and analytical insights to executive level business and finance leaders. You will be entrepreneurial by nature as Leo has a start-up mentality, analytical in approach, have a demonstrated ability to develop financial models that provide intelligence for business decisions and be able to leverage your project management skills to lead simultaneous workstreams. This role requires a self-starter with superb business partnering skills, a keen attention to detail, ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ambiguity, and a track record of deep financial analysis. The candidate must have the aptitude to incorporate new approaches and methodologies (including statistical concepts) while dealing with big data, be able to develop and define key business questions and to build data sets that answer those questions.

This role leads the financial architecture, cost accounting, and controllership functions for Amazon Leo's satellite manufacturing operations. The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance partner to manufacturing site leadership, building financial processes, systems, and governance structures in a complex, multi-site production environment. This is an opportunity to build rather than inherit—designing the controllership framework that will scale with production ramp and site expansion.


Key job responsibilities
Controllership:
The Senior Finance Manager manages the income statement and balance sheet of the manufacturing business, monitoring and tracking, cost accruals, tangible assets, monthly close, and all items with material impact on business KPIs. The role monitors free cash flow including working capital drivers and other assets and liabilities. This leader supports adherence to Amazon's financial internal controls through regular monitoring and auditing, drives culture change in developing awareness of how internal controls impact business practices, and ensures compliance with documented financial directives including support of annual internal controls assessment campaigns.

Cost Accounting & Inventory Management:
This leader owns component-to-finished-good cost accounting across complex product structures, from raw component through final satellite assembly, integration, and testing. Responsibilities include managing production variance analysis across high-mix, volume components and standardized platforms, establishing inventory valuation methods for long-lead components, sub-assemblies, and high-value work-in-progress, and leading the financial governance of engineering change orders and their impact on material costs. The role develops and maintains engineered standards, work measurement systems, labor performance metrics, learning curve analysis, and cost estimating methodologies that drive manufacturing cost accountability from the program level down to individual work centers.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management:
This role creates and executes the Annual Operating Plans and quarterly forecasts in accordance with corporate schedules and governance. The Senior Finance Manager delivers meaningful variance analysis for monthly and quarterly business reviews, providing a coherent business narrative that drives corrective actions. Responsibilities include developing manufacturing cost center budgets, labor forecasts, and program support estimates. The role builds cost and performance management systems measuring labor utilization, manufacturing efficiency/yield, budget performance, cost performance, schedule performance, forecast accuracy, and resource utilization—creating the reporting framework that ensures transparency between operational execution and financial outcomes.

Strategic Partnership & Operational Decision-Making:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the primary financial advisor to the site operations leadership team, providing strategic guidance on cost management, capital investments, and operational efficiencies. This includes analyzing results, explaining business trends, and recommending improvements. The role partners with plant managers, supply chain leaders, and business on capital investment analysis, productivity initiatives, cost reduction programs, and manufacturing process improvements. The leader provides clear and accurate financial guidance to leaders both on-site and across the broader organization, enabling optimal business decisions at every level.

Capital Planning & Investment Governance:
The role evaluates and prioritizes capital investment opportunities in manufacturing facilities and equipment, leading financial due diligence for new projects and ensuring alignment with ROI and payback criteria. This includes financial oversight and capital expenditure tracking, monitoring adherence to approved budgets, and supporting productivity initiatives that drive return on invested capital across the manufacturing footprint.

New Factory Financial Architecture & Launch Strategy:
The Senior Finance Manager develops the complete financial architecture for the manufacturing site, including labor-routing models, overhead absorption structures, and rate frameworks from inception. This includes modeling production ramp-up phases to analyze capacity constraints, cash flow implications, and break-even timelines. The role evaluates capital expenditure for automated assembly, cleanroom infrastructure, and advanced testing systems, partnering with engineering and supply chain teams to establish target costing and make-versus-buy frameworks that optimize the cost structure across satellite platforms.

ERP & Systems Leadership:
The Senior Finance Manager serves as the principal finance stakeholder for enterprise ERP and Manufacturing Execution System implementation. This includes designing the Chart of Accounts, cost centers, and work breakdown structures that form the digital financial backbone. The role automates inventory tracking, standard cost rollups, and material issuance within the manufacturing execution thread, and builds real-time financial dashboards and operational reporting tools that translate complex factory data into actionable business intelligence for site leadership.

Team Leadership & Development:
The Senior Finance Manager mentors and develops team members, fostering a continuous improvement environment. The role trains and supervises staff, interacts with peers to share ideas and develop best practices across the organization, and leads change management initiatives to improve site-level accounting, analysis, and financial decision-making capability.

Basic qualifications

- 12+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of positions that require analysis and reporting financial results experience
- 5+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 10+ years of spearheading strategic cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable financial results and advance organizational objectives experience
- 10+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of hiring, leading and developing teams experience
- 8+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 8+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- MBA, or CPA

descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a GTM Planning Lead to drive data-driven Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy and analysis within the Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of statistical analysis and GTM strategy, translating complex data into actionable insights that shape how WWPS designs territories, measures the effectiveness of coverage models, and evaluates emerging strategic initiatives.

The successful candidate will own three interconnected analytical workstreams:

Territory Design & Coverage Segmentation Analytics: Leading the quantitative analysis that underpins WWPS territory design decisions. This includes econometric regression analyses measuring how territory composition (industry purity, coverage segment purity) drives pipeline creation, building and maintaining implementation frameworks, and developing data packs that translate coverage frameworks into territory-level parameters for each division.
GTM Strategy Effectiveness Measurement: Designing and executing analytical studies that measure the impact of strategic GTM initiatives—such as FinOps strategic engagement, partner-led indirect sales motions, and greenfield coverage models—using control group methodologies and statistical rigor to quantify what is working and inform investment decisions.
Productivity Analysis & Benchmarking: Partnering with Finance to develop and refine productivity metrics frameworks, contributing to quarterly productivity reviews with senior leadership, and bench-marking seller performance across coverage segments, industries, and geographies to surface insights that drive operational improvements.
This role requires someone who combines strong quantitative skills with the business acumen to translate statistical findings into executive-ready narratives, and the cross-functional influence to drive adoption of data-backed recommendations across a complex, matrixed organization.


Key job responsibilities
Design and execute econometric analyses (regression, Shapley value decomposition) to quantify how territory composition variables—segmentation, industry, territory size—drive pipeline creation and sales outcomes across WWPS territories.

Own the WWPS Coverage Segment Implementation Framework, translating coverage segmentation principles into territory design parameters, benchmarks, and implementation guidance for each division.

Build and maintain data repositories and conduct territory inspections with stakeholders ahead of annual planning cycles.

Design analytical studies measuring the effectiveness of strategic GTM initiatives using control group methodologies to isolate impact and inform investment decisions.

Develop and review productivity metrics and bench-marking frameworks, contributing to quarterly reviews presented to GTM leaders and division leadership.

Synthesize complex analyses into executive-ready narratives and business cases for division leaders, informing coverage strategy decisions, emerging GTM investments, and opportunity prioritization.

Collaborate cross-functionally with Geo GTM leaders, Sales Operations, FSO, Enablement, and industry specialists to validate findings and integrate analytical insights into territory design and sales motions.

Develop and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical tooling enabling territory purity tracking and coverage segment monitoring at scale.

About the team
The WWPS Sales Strategy and Business Operations (SSBO) team enables the Worldwide Public Sector organization to operate at scale. The Strategic Planning & Insights (SP&I) team within SSBO designs the data and analytical frameworks that help WWPS sales teams focus on the highest-impact opportunities across Healthcare, Education, Government, National Security, and Nonprofit verticals.

title: Business Developer, Fuse
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Fuse — Business Development

Role purpose: Own strategic partnerships that expand the distribution, acquisition, and engagement of Amazon subscription services through third-party partners. Fuse BD sits at the intersection of Amazon’s subscription services and major external distribution partners, creating commercial structures that embed Amazon services into products customers already buy and use.

Core responsibilities

Originate and own strategic partnerships with telecommunications operators, broadband providers, OEMs, financial institutions, retailers, and other large-scale distribution partners. Develop distribution strategies for Amazon services including Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music, and other subscription products.

Structure and negotiate complex commercial agreements - that solve unique problems - leveraging bundle structures, free trials, wholesale arrangements, fixed-fee structures, revenue shares, promotional offers, and/or embedded subscription models.

You will own the full deal lifecycle. From identifying the right opportunity, to business case development through negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing commercial management. Build the business case and economics for partnerships, modeling customer acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, partner economics, and long-term value.

Internally, you will work across Amazon organizations, coordinating with product, finance, legal, tax, marketing, operations, engineering, and the individual subscription businesses to develop and execute partnerships.

Serve as the senior commercial relationship owner with partner executives, identifying opportunities to expand relationships across multiple Amazon businesses.

Drive post-launch performance, using subscriber, engagement, conversion, and financial data to identify under performance and develop initiatives to accelerate adoption.

Develop market and partner strategy, prioritizing the partners and distribution channels capable of generating meaningful subscriber scale.
Create repeatable partnership models that can be deployed across partners and markets rather than treating every agreement as a standalone transaction.

Navigate highly complex organizations, aligning Amazon and partner stakeholders whose objectives, economics, technical requirements, and timelines may differ.

Represent Amazon in executive-level negotiations, balancing partner objectives with Amazon’s long-term customer and economic interests.

What makes Fuse BD different from traditional BD?

The role isn’t about signing partnerships or managing accounts. It’s about solving complex business problems forging close relationships with 3P partners, that amplify distribution + corporate development + product commercialization.

A strong Fuse BD person essentially asks:

How can we solve this unique Amazon problem through 3P assets, in a way that benefits both companies AND its joint customers?




Key job responsibilities

1. Develop and execute distribution strategy — Identify where and how Amazon subscription services such as Prime, Prime Video and Amazon Music should be distributed through third-party partners.

2. Source and develop strategic partnerships — Build relationships with telcos, ISPs, OEMs and other large-scale consumer platforms that can materially expand Amazon’s reach.

3. Structure and negotiate complex deals — Lead commercial negotiations covering bundles, wholesale models, free trials, fixed fees, revenue shares, customer eligibility and other distribution constructs.

4. Own deals end-to-end — Take opportunities from initial concept and business case through internal approval, negotiation, contracting, technical integration and commercial launch.

5. Build business cases and evaluate economics — Assess subscriber potential, acquisition cost, conversion, engagement, retention and overall financial return to determine which opportunities Amazon should pursue.

6. Lead cross-functional execution — Coordinate across Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Finance, Legal, Tax, Product, Marketing, Engineering and Operations to get deals approved and launched.

7. Manage senior partner relationships — Serve as Amazon’s commercial owner with senior executives at strategic partners and expand relationships beyond individual transactions.

8. Drive post-launch performance and growth — Track subscriber acquisition, activation, engagement and economics; identify gaps and work with partners and Amazon teams to improve performance.

9. Create scalable partnership models — Turn successful deals into repeatable commercial and technical frameworks that can be deployed across additional partners, products and markets.

10. Own market/portfolio priorities — Determine where BD resources should be deployed based on partner scale, customer reach, strategic importance and expected economic impact

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional or military experience
- Experience structuring and negotiating complex agreements and leading cross-functional groups to orchestrate and successfully complete deals
- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software

Preferred qualifications

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
- Proficiency in Spanish
- Proficiency in French

descriptionHtml:
The Site WHS Officer will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in a delivery station to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. A successful Site WHS Officer will demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and inspire change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.
The Site WHS Officer must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will instruct and train Operations Leaders in Amazon WHS policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. You will work to identify best practices and incorporate these standard methodologies into our standards to continuously improve the safety landscape.
Site WHS officer will possess excellent safety program knowledge as well as environmental and ergonomic knowledge and be able demonstrate this expertise when working with Operations.
The Site WHS officer will be a part of site WHS team and reports to site WHS manager. The WHS officer should be flexible to work in shifts.
Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.


Key job responsibilities
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS standards/Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Analyze safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to rationalize the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Ensure proper Incident Investigation and closure of Corrective action and preventive action.
- Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes at the site.
- Implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury.

- Ensure site PPE compliance.
- You have to implement the best practices at site.
- Implement PIT (powered industrial truck) safety and yard safety system.
- Ensure standard Work Permit System usage at site.
- Implement and ensure safe contractor management at site.

- Work along with facility team and ensure preventive maintenance of all Fire protection and emergency equipment’s
- Ensure basic Fire Fighting training and first aid training requirements.

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work all days and shifts, including overtime (24 hours a day, 7 days a week operation, including holidays)
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience

- Experience with OSHA regulations

title: Software Development Engineer, EC2 Nitro Networking
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape the future of virtualized networking in one of the world's largest public clouds?

The Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) NX Platforms team owns the packet processing pipeline running beneath every EC2 instance — adding encryption, firewalls (security groups), routing, billing, and monitoring to every packet on every host across our worldwide fleet of 9M+ hosts in more than 30 regions. Our vision: deliver bare-metal networking performance while raising the bar on EC2's security, availability, and reliability — unlocking capabilities only possible through true Software Defined Networking (SDN).

We are growing fast and looking for senior systems engineers who can deliver ultra-high performance — our goal is processing millions of packets per second on a single CPU core. This demands highly optimized data structures, low-level hardware tuning, and expertise in C/C++. If you have a passion for systems software engineering — kernel development, embedded systems, or high-performance networking — this is a unique opportunity to define the next generation of the platform powering all new EC2 instance families and VPC features for years to come.

Your code ships to production across the entire EC2 fleet — powering services like AWS Lambda and every external workload running on EC2. With frequent deployments and full ownership from design through operation, your contributions have immediate, measurable impact at global scale.

With an extensive network and access to Principal, Sr. Principal, and Distinguished Engineers across EC2, AWS, and Amazon, there are many stretch opportunities to grow your skills and knowledge.

Ready to build the networking substrate for the world's largest cloud? Apply today.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end design, scoping, implementation, and integration testing of new features that run on the EC2 Nitro System.
- Design and build secure and scalable services to enable monitoring, diagnostics, and automated recovery.
- Design and build next generation hardware/software validation platforms that enables efficient CI/CD.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand and define requirements, design system architectures, and implement robust and scalable solutions.
- Continuously improve development processes, tools, and automation to enhance productivity and quality.
- Mentor junior engineers with scoping, design, and developing scalable and maintainable code.
