We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

title: Senior Software Dev Engineer, EC2 Hyperplane
descriptionHtml:
Come grow and lead a team building the next-generation software defined networks for AWS networking services.

Hyperplane is looking for a Software Development Engineer for a critical part of its service that delivers a distributed Network Function Virtualization (NFV) platform. This team owns distributed state and health tracking systems used for both customer-facing services such as NAT Gateway, Elastic File System, Load Balancers, AWS service endpoints as well as many internal AWS services. The successful candidate will be comfortable dealing with ambiguity, be very customer-centric and able to think big!

The ideal candidate will be passionate about the potential of cloud computing as well as about building resilient, scalable and high-performance distributed services. This strong engineer has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a rapid growth environment exhibiting abilities to prioritize well, communicate clearly and understand how to drive a high level of focus and excellence with a strong team. They are a seasoned, mature engineer who is comfortable working in a fast-paced team. We operate at very large scale and on critical workloads, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. A high level of ownership and accountability is a must.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

A successful candidate is comfortable in a leadership role and seeks to mentor and grow less experienced engineers on the team. You understand customer obsession and live and breathe operational excellence. You know when to partner with and influence other teams to deliver results. You will emphasize hiring and developing the best talent at AWS. This particular role will “float” across three two-pizza teams specializing in the connection tracking abilities of this networking platform. This is a critical role that dives deep into the intricacies of how a large-scale, distributed, software-defined network reliably tracks and load balances TCP flows.

Ready to make a durable mark on the computer industry? Come join us for this unique opportunity that blends leadership, technology, and accelerating customer growth!

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable distributed systems that power AWS EC2's network virtualization infrastructure, ensuring low-latency and high-throughput performance for millions of customer workloads
• Lead technical design and architecture decisions for critical components of the Hyperplane platform, including packet processing, network policy enforcement, and traffic management systems
• Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, raising the engineering bar across the team
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including network engineering, security, and product management to deliver customer-facing features and improvements
• Optimize system performance through profiling, benchmarking, and implementing improvements to meet stringent latency and throughput requirements
• Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot complex production issues, and drive operational excellence initiatives to improve system reliability and availability
• Contribute to long-term technical strategy and roadmap planning, identifying opportunities for innovation and architectural improvements
• Write high-quality, maintainable code in languages such as C++, Rust, or Java, following best practices for testing, documentation, and deployment

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design proposal for the new greenfield system, providing feedback that shapes the architecture before code is written. After a stand-up with your team, you spend focused time writing or reviewing code for a distributed state-tracking component. In the afternoon, you pair with a teammate to debug a tricky concurrency issue, then join a cross-team sync to align on an upcoming integration. Throughout the day, you balance hands-on technical work with coaching conversations that help the team grow.

About the team
The Hyperplane team builds and operates the foundational network virtualization platform that powers Amazon EC2. Our systems process trillions of packets daily, providing secure network isolation, policy enforcement, and traffic management for millions of customer instances across AWS regions. We are in a period of deliberate investment — rebuilding our team with experienced technical leaders, expanding into generative AI, and planning a greenfield rewrite of a critical system. It is a rare opportunity to join at a moment when you can directly influence the team's culture, technical direction, and long-term roadmap.

- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Pilot Planning

Operational Readiness & Expansion

title: Sr. Licensing Manager, Amazon MGM Studios- Consumer Products
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by turning the world's most beloved franchises into products fans can hold, wear, and experience in the real world? Amazon MGM Studios is looking for a Senior Consumer Products Licensing Manager to lead strategic licensing partnerships that bring our stories off the screen and into the lives of fans everywhere.

In this role, you'll own complex, multi-territory negotiations with major manufacturers and marquee retail partners — structuring deals that balance creative integrity with commercial ambition. You'll build multi-year franchise roadmaps, identify untapped opportunities before anyone else sees them, and partner across content, marketing, retail, and legal to launch merchandise programs that fans love and that drive meaningful growth. You'll also mentor the next generation of licensing talent and represent our business in senior leadership reviews and external partner summits.

If you thrive on navigating ambiguity, building partnerships that matter, and making data-driven decisions that shape the future of a global licensing portfolio, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Deal Structuring & Negotiation
-Lead complex, multi-territory licensing negotiations with major manufacturers and strategic retail partners
-Structure deals encompassing royalty rates, minimum guarantees, advance payments, and performance milestones
-Negotiate renewal terms and drive expansion opportunities with existing partners to grow revenue and portfolio breadth

Franchise Strategy Development
-Manage a portfolio of strategic titles and franchise licensing partnerships
-Build multi-year licensing roadmaps aligned with content release schedules, marketing campaigns, and audience growth targets
-Identify untapped category opportunities and prioritize expansion based on audience insights and competitive analysis
-Lead cross-functional franchise planning sessions with content, marketing, retail, and legal teams

Data-Driven Insight & AI-Enabled Decision-Making
-Leverage data analysis, business intelligence tools, and dashboards to identify licensing opportunities, forecast revenue, and measure partner impact
-Apply AI tools to accelerate deal analysis, market research, and reporting workflows, and champion automation that improves team efficiency
-Use AI/ML-driven insights (e.g., audience segmentation, product and category trends) to inform franchise strategy and portfolio decisions

Partner Performance & Portfolio Management
-Establish KPIs and performance benchmarks for licensing partners; conduct quarterly business reviews with top accounts
-Drive growth through proactive portfolio optimization across product categories, price points, and distribution channels
-Manage underperforming partnerships, including escalation planning, remediation strategies, and termination when required

Team Leadership & Mentorship

A day in the life
No two days look the same in Consumer Products Licensing. You might start your morning in a quarterly business review with a top apparel licensee, and map the next wave of product launches to an upcoming season premiere. By midday, you're deep in a negotiation — structuring minimum guarantees and territory rights for a multi-market toy deal — then pivoting to a cross-functional franchise planning session where you align content, marketing, and retail partners around a shared roadmap. In the afternoon, you might review product designs for brand and creative consistency, coach a teammate through a tricky partner conversation, and prepare a crisp recommendation for senior leadership on an untapped category opportunity you've identified. You move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution, always anchored in data and the fan experience.

About the team
Amazon MGM Studios' Consumer Products Licensing (CPL) team exists to enable fans to discover, experience, and purchase products from their favorite franchises across Prime Video's key regions. We drive awareness and fan engagement through best-in-class brand partnerships and generate revenue from licensed merchandise, interactive games, and real-world experiences.

We're a world-class team that sets bold visions, makes data-driven decisions, and leverages technology to scale our business — maximizing existing IP through strategic brand partnerships, prioritizing new series and films with established fan bases, and driving operational excellence globally. We're growing, investing in our people, and building the infrastructure to become a premier licensing destination. If you want to shape how the world's favorite stories show up in fans' lives, this is the team for you.

title: Director, Software Development - Language Foundations, Amazon SW Builder Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX), started in 2022, is working to make Amazon the best place to build software. Every day, hundreds of thousands of Amazon software builders rely on us for the tools they build with, and for the technology, training, and community behind them. One of our most important responsibilities is shaping the language ecosystem, both inside Amazon and across the open-source community, to improve the experience for every software builder.

The Role
We are seeking a Director of Software Development to lead Language Foundations, the organization that owns Amazon's programming-languages strategy across our strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift) and represents that strategy to the language community: the engineers who specialize in language design, compilation, and optimization, along with standards bodies and the open-source ecosystems Amazon depends on. This leader recruits and leads some of the world's foremost language specialists, many of them Principal Engineers with deep standing in their fields.

Language Foundations shapes and influences the direction of the world's most critical programming languages. Amazon sits on the Rust Foundation board, is one of the distributors of OpenJDK (Amazon Corretto), and sponsors resident engineers who are among the top contributors in their communities. This leader is central to Amazon's large-scale language modernization, owning the tooling and language foundations that enable teams to move to modern languages and runtimes and transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software they run. It is simultaneously a community-shaping and an internal-modernization challenge: strengthening the ecosystems that Amazon and the industry rely on, while helping modernize some of the largest services in the world.

Key job responsibilities
● Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Language Foundations, connecting it to builder impact: code quality, reliability, security, performance, and the enablement of agent-supervised development.
● Deliver best-in-class support for Amazon's strategic languages (Java, Rust, Python, TypeScript, Go, C/C++, Kotlin, and Swift), aligning internal toolchains with industry conventions so builders and agents work on modern runtimes out of the box.
● Lead Amazon's language modernization through the tooling and language foundations that transform the performance, efficiency, and safety of the software teams build and run, including large-scale Rust and Java runtime investments.
● Build the trusted, secure repository for the third-party software Amazon depends on, curating out unmaintained and vulnerable dependencies so builders start from a safe default.
● Shape the external direction of strategic programming languages through Amazon's participation in standards bodies, foundations (e.g., the Rust Foundation, OpenJDK), and the open-source community, while maintaining the cultural norms of those communities.
● Lead and grow a multi-team engineering organization: recruit and develop world-class language specialists and Principal Engineers and build the leadership bench.
● Influence strategy and technical direction at the most senior levels of the company through clear written narrative and data; briefs at CEO-level reviews.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
- 10+ years of software development experience, including systems software, compilers, language runtimes, or developer toolchains.
- 5+ years managing people, with 3+ years managing multiple managers or teams.
- Experience developing long-term technical vision and strategy and influencing leadership decisions.
- Experience delivering large-scale technical programs across multiple teams or organizations.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
- A leadership position on a team delivering solutions at Amazon or industry scale.
- Proven track record of attracting, developing, and retaining top language and systems specialists, including engineers with standing in the open-source community.
- Active participation in the language community, including membership or leadership in standards bodies, foundations, or major open-source projects.
- Deep expertise in programming language design, runtimes, compilers, or developer ecosystems, with recognized standing in the language community.
- Experience leading large-scale language or platform migrations in complex, multi-service environments.

title: Embedded Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Leo Customer Terminal Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

You will design, craft, and deploy reliable embedded software for large quantity of consumer electronic products. Amazon LEO is breaking new ground with every device we design, and you will be an integral part of bringing this family of products to customers.

Key job responsibilities
· Develop embedded software for Customer Terminal devices within the Amazon LEO system.
· Participate in all phases of SDLC including requirements gathering, design, code, test, and code/test coverage.
· Developing embedded software in C, C++, Rust, Python or other languages
· Have experience with real-time embedded software philosophies and practices
· Have expertise with Linux and/or RTOS
· Review schematics, logic analyzer, and embedded software trouble-shooting techniques.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


A day in the life
As part of our Amazon LEO Customer Terminal Software Team, you will design and implement embedded software used in the Amazon LEO products. You will work in a collaborative environment with teams inside and outside of Amazon. You will craft your software from requirements, designs, code, test, to product deployment. You need to be flexible and responsive to changing priority issues.

About the team
The Amazon LEO Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect our customers to the Amazon LEO network. We provide software for both applications and the underlying Linux system. We work hand in hand with hardware, product and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in embedded wireless systems

title: Employee Relations Investigator, International Markets Centralized Investigations (IMCI)
descriptionHtml:

If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history. We are looking for a dynamic, organized self-starter to join our International Markets Centralized Investigation (IMCI) team as an Employee Relations (ER) Investigator supporting our Mexico, Colombia and Costa Rica locations.

The central objective of the IMCI team is to thoroughly and expeditiously investigate all associate concerns in a fair, unbiased and consistent manner.

The ideal candidate for this position has strong communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrates an ability to earn trust, dive deep and work successfully on a broad spectrum of HR, employee and labor relations issues and business challenges. The ideal candidate has demonstrable experience in Human Resources (HR) and Employee Relations.

Candidates must possess a valid Colombian law degree to be considered for this role

-Investigate highly sensitive HR and Employee Relations issues, including: Conducting complainant, witness and subject interviews; Analyzing data from various internal systems; Case adjudication; Proposing remedial action based on investigation findings; Production of completed investigation documentation
-Independently manage assigned casework, bringing investigations to closure rapidly and definitively
-Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee and stakeholder feedback
-Analyze aggregate casework data to identify issue trends and opportunities for proactive issue mitigation
-Analyze casework trends and produce strategic recommendations to the business to proactively address systemic issues

You will build broader relationships with digital marketing decision makers, including CMOs, CTOs, procurement and marketing leaders, as well as programmatic advertising leaders to further educate holistic reasons for deeper investment within programmatic. You will work collaboratively with other sales teams and product teams internally, enabling solutions for marketers and creating significant new business opportunities for Amazon Advertising. You are also responsible for building cross functional internal partnerships with AWS in order to bring to client stakeholders innovative solutions that bridge cloud and Ad Tech products.

The ideal candidate will have a business development, enterprise sales or digital marketing background, experience selling and implementing large-scale projects with marketers at the CMO/CXO/VP or senior decision maker level, and a deep understanding of programmatic media, SaaS companies and ad tech partners used by enterprise marketers. title: Software Development Engineer, Region Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

Are you passionate about building tools that empower teams across all of Amazon Web Services? Join us as a Software Development Engineer II where you'll own and deliver features for internal platforms that enable AWS teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale. Your work will directly impact how thousands of builders across AWS develop, deploy, and operate services that millions of customers depend on daily.

In this role, you'll design and implement solutions for difficult technical problems, working with a talented team of Software Development Engineers and System Development Engineers. You'll take feature requirements from concept through delivery, making design decisions and navigating trade-offs independently. Beyond your own contributions, you'll raise the bar for the team by providing meaningful code review feedback, mentoring newer engineers, and identifying opportunities to improve developer productivity and operational excellence. This is an opportunity for experienced engineers who want to own impactful work while deepening their expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering best practices.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and deliver features end-to-end for internal AWS tools and services, owning work from technical design through deployment and ongoing operational support
- Solve difficult technical problems across the development stack, evaluating multiple implementation approaches and making sound trade-offs to arrive at solutions that balance customer needs with long-term maintainability
- Provide meaningful code review feedback to teammates, including more senior engineers, raising the bar on code quality, testing practices, and engineering standards across the team
- Identify and advocate for improvements to developer productivity, operational excellence, and team processes, driving changes that make the team more effective over time
- Mentor newer engineers through constructive code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, helping onboard new team members and accelerating their growth
- Collaborate cross-functionally throughout the software development lifecycle, contributing to design reviews, documentation, and stakeholder communication while resolving technical disagreements through constructive dialog

A day in the life
Your typical day involves owning and delivering features for internal tools that impact teams across AWS. You'll spend time designing solutions to technical challenges, writing code, and providing thoughtful code review feedback to teammates. You might lead a design discussion for a new capability, debug a complex issue reported by an internal customer, or identify an opportunity to improve an existing system's reliability or performance. You balance hands-on coding with the broader thinking needed to make sound technical trade-offs.

You'll join a collaborative team of Software Development Engineers and System Development Engineers who are passionate about building tools that make AWS teams more effective. Our team values knowledge sharing and mentorship, with a broad mix of experience levels and tenures. As an SDE II, you'll play an active role in onboarding new team members, sharing context about our systems, and helping less experienced engineers grow through pairing and constructive feedback.

We care about your career growth and provide opportunities to deepen your technical expertise through increasingly complex challenges. Our team supports an inclusive culture where different perspectives drive innovation, and we strive for flexibility that enables you to bring your best to both work and life. Together, we're creating the foundational tools that enable AWS to continue innovating for customers worldwide.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

title: Head of Channel Partnerships, MCCF
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment (MCCF) is seeking a strong leader to build and scale our channel partnerships with agencies, consultancies, and supply chain experts, leading a high-performing team of 7 Partner Managers.
Externalizing Amazon's supply chain services to reach merchants beyond our own channels is one of MCCF's biggest growth opportunities, and partners are central to unlocking it. This role owns the channel strategy for capturing that opportunity: driving upper-funnel demand for Amazon's externalized supply chain services through the partner ecosystem. Working through partners, the team generates awareness and demand among partners' merchant bases, feeds qualified leads and opportunities to our sales teams, and finds new ways to scale our shared book of business. Success is measured by partner onboarding and enablement, and by the leads and demand generated for Sales.
This is a high-visibility, strategic role in a high-growth business. The leader sets the vision for the channel, collaborates with senior leaders across Amazon, and engages directly at the C-suite level with our partners and with leading eCommerce brands to shape long-term, mutually beneficial growth. The ideal candidate is a data-driven operator who thinks big, builds trusted relationships with decision-makers and executives at prospective partners, and delivers ambitious growth targets while raising the bar on partner experience.


Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
• Own partner onboarding, enablement, and lead generation for the sales team.
• Attract, retain, and scale top talent; mentor and coach Partner Managers.
• Set short- and long-term goals and execution plans, and build the programs and tools that improve team performance.
• Drive strategic plans for top agency, consultancy, and SI partners, prioritizing opportunities by their new-seller acquisition impact.
• Build and own executive relationships with key partners to set direction and unlock scaled growth.
• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Dev, Finance, and Legal to execute the channel strategy.
• Represent partner and industry needs to influence product innovation and keep Amazon's value proposition differentiated.


About the team
MCCF extends Amazon's world-class shopping and logistics capabilities to merchants' own sales channels beyond Amazon. MCCF lets merchants use Amazon's fulfillment network to pick, pack, ship, and deliver orders from off-Amazon sales channels. For over 20 years, Amazon has empowered businesses to grow, and MCCF is the next step in helping merchants of all sizes grow their business — on Amazon or beyond.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 10+ years of driving growth through and with cross-functional teams including inside sales, technical, marketing, segmentation, legal (contracts) experience
- Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent
- 7+ years of eCommerce experience, including how companies leverage different technologies in DTC.
- Direct deal flow experience.
- Experience with consistently generating business: efficiently managing team’s workload across a pipeline of unique projects

Preferred qualifications

- Excellent verbal and written skills and ability to influence others internally and externally.
- Ability to excel as a self-starter in a fast-paced and fluid “startup” environment.
- Ability to think strategically and creatively, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative inputs while applying sound business judgment.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Customer Experience Improvement
descriptionHtml:
The Customer Experience Improvement (CXI) Product and Tech team ensures we continue to raise the bar on customer experience across Amazon's diverse array of businesses, products, and services. We build the intelligence and automation that identifies customer experience improvement opportunities, based on customer feedback signals, and converts them into systematic corrective action at marketplace scale.

Our solutions power the full defect elimination lifecycle: ML models that detect emerging defect patterns before they compound, LLM-based investigation tools that confirm root causes without human intervention, and agentic workflows that drive resolution through the right upstream team. We operate across every marketplace and defect category — from misleading detail pages to chronic damage to expired inventory — partnering with retail, seller services, supply chain, and science to close the loop between detection and fix.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager who can drive delivery across this system. You'll own cross-functional execution for a platform that spans multiple AI/ML workstreams, coordinate with resolver teams who own the upstream fix, and build the mechanisms that scale defect elimination beyond what any single team could achieve manually. The work is technically deep (agentic AI, detection models, data pipelines), organizationally complex (10+ partner teams with competing priorities), and high-impact (hundreds of millions in prevented concessions, tens of thousands of defects eliminated annually). If you thrive at the intersection of AI systems delivery and cross-org program leadership — and want to build something that directly protects customers — this is the role.


Key job responsibilities
As a Technical Program Manager in this team, you will:

- Interact with Product Managers, other TPMs, and multiple development teams to define, design, and deliver complex product features.
- Manage all aspects of project execution and lead efficient delivery of large programs.
- Devise technical specifications and system integration plans, and demonstrate the ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, and evaluate new ideas, design, and solution choices.
- Identify bottlenecks, risks, and issues at different stages of the program. Provide escalation management, trade-offs, and mitigations, balancing the business need and technical constraints.
- Drive the technology strategy, collaborate with business and development teams across the company to analyze the cost/benefit of project selection.
- Engage with and influence cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership; and keep everyone informed through regular reporting, status reviews, and other mechanisms.

A day in the life
A typical day might include: unblocking an engineering team waiting on a data access approval from a partner org, reviewing a design for a new agentic investigation workflow, running a cross-org sync with resolver teams to align on launch timelines, and synthesizing progress across multiple workstreams into a leadership update with clear asks. You'll context-switch between technical depth and organizational navigation — often in the same meeting. You'll also leverage AI tools in your own workflow to move faster: using agents to pull ticket data and surface patterns, generating status reports from project trackers, and drafting technical specs that you refine with engineering. The systems you're delivering use AI to eliminate defects at scale — and you'll use AI to manage the complexity of delivering them.

descriptionHtml:
Since opening our 'virtual' doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. That can be described in one of our core Leadership Principles, which is Bias for Action. This means that our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces.

Amazon is seeking self-motivated Driver Trainers to join our team and help build a network of customer-centric Delivery Associates in the communities where we operate. As a Driver Trainer, you have a passion for mentoring others; you are comfortable teaching and guiding conversations in large groups; and you believe in hands-on training and conducting drive-alongs with Delivery Associates to instill safe practices.

As a Driver Trainer, you are responsible for establishing the right driver training culture in your delivery station, setting up the training experience, and independently instructing training sessions. You educate Delivery Associates on the foundational safety, quality, and productivity aspects that are an important part of the Delivery Associate daily routine. You enable the success of Delivery Associates by adapting to different learning styles and taking a hands-on training approach to demonstrate what good looks like. You exhibit Learn and Be Curious by answering all Delivery Associates’ questions and finding the answers if you are not sure of the correct response.

As a Driver Trainer, you are expected to lead by example and demonstrate the Amazon Leadership Principles at all times. In this position you will play a key role in keeping our commitment to exceed customer expectations by ensuring Delivery Associates are set up for success to deliver customer orders, large or small, on time at the right place.

Due to interstate operating authority commerce regulations, candidates must be at least 21 years or older. Candidate must hold a valid state-appropriate driver’s license, be able to obtain and maintain their Driver Qualification File (DQF), and be eligible to drive in accordance with Department of Transportation (DOT) requirements.

• Effectively operate a GPS

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
How would you like to be a part of Earth’s most customer-centric company? You would work with teams of front-line responders who support the operations of some of the world’s most powerful data centers. Our Data Center Engineering Operations team maintain and operate our critical infrastructure systems so that they are prepared to stand up against any situation.

AWS has the world’s largest cloud computing portfolio. As an Amazonian you will work in some of the most sophisticated, safe, and secure data centers in the world. Our Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT’s) help keep them that way by working with the brightest minds from around the globe to help test and implement the newest technology and work practices to meet the demands of a changing market.

We have a passion for learning and evolving, it’s how we have helped define ourselves as leaders in the industry. Let’s work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Work Schedule:
Our Data Centers operate 24/7 and require on-site presence. This position offers two shift schedule options:

Option 1: Weekend Rotation
- Days Worked: Sunday - Tuesday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Option 2: Weekday Rotation
- Days Worked: Wednesday - Friday, plus every other Saturday
- Weekly Pattern: Alternates between 3-day and 4-day work weeks
- Shift Hours: 5:30am - 6:00pm (day shift) OR 5:30pm - 6:00am (night shift)

Both schedules follow a rotating pattern where you'll work 3 days one week and 4 days the following week.

Overtime & Pay
- Overtime: Time and a half after 40 hours per week
- Night Shift Differential: 13% additional pay (6:00pm - 6:00am shifts)
- Maximum Hours: 60 hours per week in total (up to 20 hours of overtime)

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- 2+ years of practical experience in electrical systems, mechanical systems, HVAC, and/or fire suppression systems

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Strong programming skills in at least two of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

title: Sr Robotics Software Engineer, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics is building a brand-new robotics manipulation platform, and we need a versatile software engineer to help bring it to life. In this role, you will own critical software components spanning robotics middleware, health monitoring, and fleet management — systems that must work reliably for a single robot and scale to fleets of thousands. You will work across a broad technology stack, from real-time C++ on the robot to full-stack web applications on AWS, while applying generative AI to automate and streamline operational workflows.

This is a greenfield opportunity where your architectural decisions will shape how Amazon's next generation of robotic systems operate. You will lead multi-engineer projects, influence technical direction across peer teams, and mentor junior engineers — all while writing exemplary code that sets the standard for your team. If you are a curious, adaptable engineer who thrives on solving hard problems across multiple technology domains, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

On a given day you might be writing real-time C++ for robot control in the morning, reviewing a teammate's AWS service design after lunch, and prototyping a generative AI workflow automation by end of day. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across peer robotics and operations teams to align on priorities, unblock dependencies, and share technical insights — while also carving out focused time for deep, heads-down engineering work.

descriptionHtml:

Do you know the systems that run the medical technology industry, from connected devices and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) to regulated quality systems, manufacturing, and global supply chains? Most of all, do you want to lead a team of Solutions Architects who help the world's leading MedTech companies migrate, modernize, and innovate on the cloud?

Amazon is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders. We try new things and dream big dreams. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are inventing the future of cloud computing. AWS is where the cloud first came to life. Now we're inventing for the decades ahead. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, builders, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud computing technologies that help our customers do more with technology and change the world in their industries.

We are looking for an experienced, customer-obsessed leader to hire, coach, and grow a team of Solutions Architects dedicated to Medical Technology (MedTech) customers in our US Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) organization. MedTech is a distinct segment for AWS. It is built on large-scale migration and data center exit programs, and it is increasingly shaped by connected care, generative AI, and intelligent manufacturing. Your team will be trusted technical advisors to customer executives and engineering leaders. They will help customers design architectures that meet the demands of a highly regulated industry while getting products to market faster.

You need to be technically credible with both customers and architects. You should understand the medical device lifecycle, from design controls and regulatory submission through manufacturing, distribution, and post-market surveillance. You will develop your team's skills in solution selling, architecture design, presentations, and executive engagement, and you will build the specialized domain depth that sets them apart in this industry. You will also work closely with sales, business development, specialist teams, AWS service teams, Professional Services, and partners, and represent your team to executive leadership.

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.


A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)

title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.


As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians

- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets

- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills

- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance

- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.

Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

title: Data Scientist, Alexa Connections
descriptionHtml:
As a Data Scientist in Alexa Connections, you will lead the end-to-end development of machine learning and data science solutions that power intelligent communication experiences across channels such as calling, messaging and email. You will partner closely with product, engineering, and business leaders to translate ambiguous problems into scalable ML models, experimentation frameworks, and data-driven product decisions. In this role, you will design and deploy advanced ML and statistical models for capabilities such as prioritization, intent detection, and proactive action recommendations. You will analyze large-scale datasets and run rigorous experiments, including A/B testing and causal analysis, to measure impact and continuously improve customer engagement and product performance. Additionally, you will shape the applied science roadmap and collaborate with global cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven solutions that scale to millions of Alexa customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with product, engineering, operations, and security teams to translate complex business problems into scalable, production-ready data science and ML solutions.
- Own the full lifecycle of model development, including exploratory analysis, model design, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
- Define and track success metrics, conduct rigorous analyses, and provide insights that guide product launches, feature improvements, and data-driven decision-making.
- Build data-driven business cases to prioritize science initiatives and demonstrate measurable impact of ML solutions.
- Develop ML-powered systems supporting key business areas.
- Lead research and analysis to understand customer interactions with Alexa, and enhance overall customer experience.
- Contribute to the broader science community by mentoring analysts, improving data workflows and tooling, and publishing technical work in internal and external forums.

• Leading or joining working sessions with Product Managers to refine problem statements new initiatives.
• Exploring new features and model architectures, leveraging AWS services, documentation, and upskilling yourself to the latest technologies.
• Leverage pre-trained LLMs to build applications that solve business problems for Connections experiences.
• Meet with Sr. Engineers/Principal Engineers to align on solution designs.
• Own or co-own MBR, WBR documents that are reviewed with Connections leadership team.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data scientist experience
- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL and statistical/mathematical programming software packages like R, SPSS, CPLEX, LONDO or Xpress

- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
- Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance

title: Sr. RFIC Design Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Come work at Amazon!

The Role:
As a Sr. RFIC Design Engineer, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive and design innovative product solutions. You will work closely with an internal inter-disciplinary team, and third party suppliers to drive key aspects of product definition, execution and optimization. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment.

As a member of the RFIC team, you will be responsible for the architectural definition, design, simulation, layout, and extracted simulation for transmit and receive front-ends from data converters to LNAs and PAs. Strong focus will be on creating power and cost optimized solutions for a given system performance.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with communications systems, digital design, and chip implementation teams to specify and implement transceivers and RFIC front-end models which will delight future Kuiper customers.
• Lead implementation of area/power-efficient RFIC chips with multiple transceiver chains with integrated PLLs from concept to production.
• Work closely with packaging/HW/EE/FW teams to ensure seamless system integration providing best value for Kuiper customers.
• Collaborate with the digital design team to define analog/digital boundary requirements for circuit calibration, clock generation, and timing.
• Explore architectures for mm-wave and RF circuits like VCOs, mixers, phase shifters, LNAs, PAs, LO distribution, frequency multipliers and dividers, and envelope/power detectors, and make detailed presentations on power/area/performance trade-offs.
• Design and simulate on-chip inductors, baluns, and power combiners in tools such as EMX or HFSS.
• Perform circuit layout, RLC extraction, and run extracted simulation across various corners to make sure designs are robust and can be taken to volume production.
• Specify bench and production test plans for your designs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 8+ years of experience in mm-Wave/RFIC design, preferably in an advanced node
- Knowledge of current and upcoming RF standards in cellular (4G/5G NR), WiMAX, 802.11ad, microwave backhaul, or similar broadband wireless standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
- RF transceiver architecture / design for beamforming systems (including zero-IF transceivers, low-IF transceivers, polar transmitters, and RF/LO/Baseband phase shifting).
- Experience leading integrated RF transceiver chipsets containing LNAs, PAs, ADCs, DACs, baseband filters, mixers, etc.
- Millimeter-wave circuit design and layout in FinFET, SOI, BiCMOS, and Bulk CMOS technologies.
- Analog circuit design fundamentals, such as Opamps, precision biasing, and LDOs. Electromagnetics of passive devices and device physics of leading edge silicon and III-V devices.
- Mixed-signal design and verification techniques.
- Experience with RF test equipment such as network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and probe-stations.
- Strong written and verbal skills.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT Automated Inventory Management
descriptionHtml:
The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon’s global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon’s business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are on the cutting edge in automated large-scale business, inventory and supply chain planning and optimization systems. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.

The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Responsibilities may include: - Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
- Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
- Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
- Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
- Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
- Developing dashboards and insight products
- Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: Kernel/OS Engineer, EC2 Nitro Instance Lifecycle Management
descriptionHtml:
EC2 Core Compute drives the planet’s largest, fastest growing and most feature-rich compute cloud. Nitro is AWS’ ground-up design for virtualization at global scale built on a fully custom stack of hardware, firmware and applications. Nitro has enabled EC2 to support Intel, AMD and Amazon’s custom silicon - the Graviton processor family - while raising the industry bar for security and performance across our product line. We integrate hardware, firmware, application software and services to deliver new virtualized and bare-metal compute platforms for companies from startups through the Fortune 500.

As a skilled engineer with expertise in C, you'll work on software that provide essential services to customer instances and EC2 dataplane applications. This role offers unique opportunities to design and build high-performance, reliable services that operate at massive scale to ensure customers are able to launch instances successfully while simultaneously protecting droplet resources from potential security threats.

This position requires an engineer who thrives in an embedded systems environment and can deliver robust solutions for the infrastructure that underpins AWS services. You'll help shape the future of cloud computing by creating efficient, scalable, and secure services that operate close to the hardware. Your contributions will directly impact customer experience and the performance of one of the world's largest cloud platforms.


Key job responsibilities
