title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Our team — Quick Core Experience — owns the platform layer behind Amazon Quick, an agentic, AI-powered digital workspace. We deliver the critical infrastructure every feature depends on: asset metadata services (indexing, search, list, favorites), real-time customization, the core design system, and enterprise governance adherence across web, mobile, and desktop experiences in Quick.

Quick is where generative AI meets the enterprise workplace. Chat, custom agents, research, BI, workflow automation — all unified, fast, discoverable, and governed at scale. The platform we build is what makes that possible.

We're looking for a full-stack engineer energized by hard problems on both sides of the stack. You design and operate large-scale distributed systems, and you love crafting scalable front-end experiences. You'll own real problems: high-throughput indexing pipelines that unify writes across dozens of producer teams, real-time customization services scaling across regions and tenants, and the search and discovery experiences that make the platform feel effortless.

You bring a strong sense of ownership, a high bar for code quality, and genuine passion for design and architecture. You don't just know how to solve problems — you build solutions to address them. You challenge yourself and others to constantly find better solutions. You partner with product managers, UX designers, and fellow engineers to turn ambiguous customer needs into shipped, polished features.

This role offers wide scope, real ownership, and the chance to shape Enterprise governance layers we add in Quick, that every team in the product depends on.

Key job responsibilities
* Lead the design and implementation of distributed systems, providing system-wide architectural guidance
* Build Agents to ease on-boarding and evaluation of Enterprise governance across Quick features and Quick accounts.
* Balance speed of execution with architectural requirements, identifying one-way door decisions that require the right long-term solution
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices and operational excellence across the team
* Solve complex technical problems with multiple risks and roadblocks, bringing clarity through simple, well-designed solutions
* Mentor and coach multiple engineers, helping develop the next generation of technical talent
Effectively communicate technical designs to both technical and non-technical audiences

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.


Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Network Deployment Technician, GND-NASA-Deploy
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Network Deployment Technician at AWS, you will get to help build and maintain a Cloud Computing Infrastructure across a number of data center and colocation sites in the Americas.

The role involves some periods working independently of your team and requires the ability to drive change while maintaining excellent communication.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation and configuration of routers, switches and DWDM hardware.
• Troubleshoot fiber optic and copper cabling, network installations and configuration.
• Coordinating colocation remote hands for new capacity installations.
• Work cross functionally with internal partners to deliver network capacity projects.
• Resolving data center and facility issues.
• Identify, coordinate, and remediate outside plant (OSP) connectivity issues.
• Lead small to mid-size network deployment projects.
• Building relationships with remote teams to ensure swift response times to events.
• Performing site audits to ensure safety and quality meets AWS standards.
• Improving all operational processes within each site and/or cage.
• Providing status updates to stakeholders via internal tools.
• Decommissioning of cable and network hardware in collaboration with partner teams as needed.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. title: Grid Analyst EMEA, Infrastructure Energy Team (IET) | Amazon Web Services
descriptionHtml:
AWS is building one of the largest energy portfolios in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa — and we need someone who can connect the dots across a complex, multi-country programme. As a Grid Analyst, you will drive programme visibility and business analytics for the energy infrastructure that powers AWS data centres across EMEA.

This is not a desk-bound reporting role. You will own the programme rhythm — aggregating data from multiple workstreams, building dashboards that surface risks early, and ensuring leadership has a clear, single view of cost, schedule, and capacity across the portfolio. You will work at the intersection of programme management and analytics, turning fragmented project data into decisions.

Day to day, you will:

- Build and maintain portfolio-level reporting that tracks grid connection milestones, utility timelines, and energisation schedules across EMEA markets
- Design automated dashboards and KPI frameworks using tools like Smartsheet and QuickSight
- Drive programme cadence
- Partner with legal, finance, and capacity delivery teams to align cost and schedule across workstreams
- Identify process gaps and implement improvements that reduce manual effort and increase reporting accuracy
- Provide analytical context on grid connection timelines and regulatory requirements to support decision-making

This role suits someone with strong programme management and business analytics skills who wants to apply them in the fast-moving energy infrastructure space. Prior power or utility experience is a plus but not required — what matters is your ability to structure ambiguity, build clarity from data, and keep complex programmes on track.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


Key job responsibilities
- Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance Capacity Delivery) on the day-to-day programme management and reporting across the portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Enable effective decision making by managing and aggregating datasets and key performance indicators from multiple sources to provide a single source of truth on status, cost, capacity and key dates management across a portfolio of infrastructure power delivery projects

- Develop and oversee the implementation of continual process improvement initiatives related to operational efficiency, team effectiveness and new value-add activities

- Facilitate internal and external meetings by managing agendas, facilitating scheduling, owning meeting minutes, and following through on action items

- Coordinate and report on capex/programme implications

- Design and develop reporting dashboards and automated reporting solutions using tools such as Smartsheet and QuickSight

A day in the life
Your morning starts with data — scanning dashboards for overnight changes across the EMEA portfolio: a shifted energisation date in the Nordics, a permitting milestone in Ireland, updated cost forecasts in Southern Europe. You triage what matters before the weekly programme review. By mid-morning, you are the connective tissue between legal, finance, & capacity delivery — translating grid timelines into business context. Afternoons shift between building QuickSight dashboards that shape investment decisions & driving process improvements that eliminate manual reporting. Some weeks you support leadership deep-dives or stand up reporting frameworks for new country teams. No two weeks look the same.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Technical for Lead Qualification , Marketing Technology, AI, and Analytics (TAA)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Marketing is looking for a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own lead qualification: the machine learning (ML) service that connects Marketing investment to sales outreach. Marketing generates the demand. Your service determines which of that demand is handed off to Sales, starting from the needs of sellers, partners and the Marketing Operations teams who manage the funnel.

ML is at the core of this role. You will evolve a deep-learning propensity model that scores each lead's readiness and likelihood to convert, and own the tooling Marketing Operations uses to see scoring impact, qualify segments and manage exceptions.

You will own lead qualification end to end: deciding how and when leads qualify, setting the thresholds and suppression rules behind those decisions, and keeping qualified leads flowing to Sales based on seller and partner needs. Your focus is delivering qualified leads, making scoring more accurate and transparent, and finding new qualification opportunities in existing demand.

Scope and Impact
ML qualification is how AWS Marketing produces Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) at global scale, so a change to the model, its thresholds or the flow of leads reaches every seller and partner who receives them. Small improvements compound across the funnel, which gives this role considerable scope and complexity. Every lead surfaced that would otherwise be missed is return on Marketing investment already made.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the lead qualification roadmap and priorities, including new opportunities to qualify leads from existing demand using customer engagement signals, and make sound trade-offs when data is incomplete.
- Define how and when leads qualify, and set the propensity-score thresholds and suppression rules that determine which leads advance to Sales.
- Drive new iterations of the scoring model with Data Science and engineering teams: translate business problems into model requirements, evaluate technical proposals, and run A/B tests before launching changes globally.
- Own the tooling and exception process Marketing Operations uses to qualify segments and handle cases the model does not.
- Keep qualified leads flowing to sellers and partners, define leading indicators that surface delivery or scoring regressions early, and lead full-funnel diagnosis when conversion or delivery changes.
- Influence without authority across Sales, Marketing Operations and Data Science, bringing stakeholders along from hypothesis through test to scale.
- Represent internal customers by generalizing requirements across sellers, partners and Marketing Operations, and staying close to how qualified leads perform in the field.
- Write the narratives, such as press release and FAQ documents and business cases, that align senior leaders on qualification decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 6+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

descriptionHtml:

As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation

- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

title: Data Quality Specialist - Catalan, AGI Data Services - G T Quality
descriptionHtml:
Quality Specialists play a vital role in establishing and maintaining comprehensive quality frameworks across our operations. Their primary responsibility begins with developing robust quality strategies in collaboration with customers and CPMs, encompassing metrics, audit approaches, and specific targets for each workflow. When quality issues arise, these specialists create prescriptive actions, examining data patterns to formulate effective solutions. They maintain a continuous improvement cycle by managing a critical feedback loop between operations and customers, drawing insights from multiple sources including quality auditors, side-by-side observations, and metric analysis. Through regular side-by-side sessions, they identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements. The specialists serve as key escalation points for customer concerns, providing strategic recommendations based on their deep understanding of processes. They consistently evaluate quality tools, suggesting refinements to enhance effectiveness, while simultaneously maintaining and updating process documentation to ensure standardization and clarity across all workflows. This comprehensive approach ensures quality remains at the forefront of our operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
* Define and implement quality metrics for established workflows
* Create prescriptive actions for quality issues
* Partner with customers, operations and internal support teams to optimize workflow quality
* Conduct side-by-sides to identify opportunities for workflow enhancement and quality improvements
* Analyze data trends and develop solutions
* Monitor quality performance and coach operations teams
* Create and maintain quality metrics reports
* Handle customer escalations and recommendations
* Evaluate and suggest improvements for quality tools
* Support process documentation and implementation

A day in the life
Your day starts by checking quality dashboards for your assigned workflows — reviewing audit scores, appeal rates, SLA status, and any overnight escalations. You will spend approximately 30% of your time on analysis: reviewing data trends, investigating root causes of quality dips, and creating prescriptive actions for operations teams.

Another 30% goes to stakeholder communication: leading weekly customer meetings, preparing quality reports, and handling escalations. The remaining time is split between process work (updating SOPs, refining audit rubrics, conducting side-by-sides) and calibration activities (aligning audit standards with Senior Quality Auditors and operations teams).

You are measured on: SLA metrics (appeals and batch completion), customer satisfaction, quality improvement trends for your workflows, and documentation quality.

About the team
The Quality Operations team within FAI Data Services ensures that labeled training data meets accuracy and consistency standards before it is used to train Amazon's AI models. Quality Specialists own the quality strategy for assigned workflows, bridging the gap between operations execution and customer expectations.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Advanced-level proficiency in Catalan language (C1+ or equivalent fluency by Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) standards)
- 1+ years of experience in a quality assurance, quality control, or data quality role
- Experience defining, tracking, and reporting quality metrics or KPIs
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop prescriptive actions
- Experience working with data to identify trends, patterns, and quality issues
- Ability to create and maintain process documentation, SOPs, or quality guidelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience with external customer interaction
- Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Linguistics, Data Science, Business, or related discipline)
- Demonstrated ability to build or improve quality frameworks, audit processes, or feedback loops
- Experience coaching or providing quality feedback to operations or associate-level teams
- Ability to adapt to fast-paced environments with evolving workflows, priorities, and quality targets
- Experience in machine learning data operations, annotation quality, or content review workflows

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - GREF Workplace Support Tech
descriptionHtml:
The GREF Workplace Support Technology team, part of Finance Automation, develops services, products, and tools to enable Amazon's corporate real estate team to build and operate the company's global facilities in more than 60 countries, which is the largest corporate real estate footprint in the world. We builds the software that keeps Amazon's global workplaces running — from the helpdesk chat and ticketing systems employees use to report issues, to the automation that routes and resolves millions of facilities work orders behind the scenes. As an SDE II, you'll own services end to end across our Amazon Connect, AI-assisted triage, and work-order integration stack, shipping features that thousands of employees and facilities agents depend on every day.

We are seeking a passionate software development engineer who can help us create the next generation of real estate systems and support the GREF organization.

As a software development engineer in the team, you will get to collaborate with product managers, senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation organization. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership on decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About the team
The Workplace Support Tech team sits within FinAuto Global Real Estate & Facilities and is on a multi-year mission to transform how Amazon employees get help with their physical workplace worldwide — from reporting a facilities issue to getting it resolved. We build the helpdesk, intelligent ticket-routing, and work-order automation that keep Amazon's buildings running, backed by Amazon Connect agent tooling and AI-assisted resolution. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) serves customers and developers who rely on storage, compute, and our other service capabilities. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.

AWS is growing rapidly, and we are looking for a Data Center Security Manager to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

-Manage data center security

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 1+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment, or 1+ years of relevant discipline work experience
- Knowledge of the administration and operation of: access control systems (Lenel, Milestone) and CCTV systems with digital recording

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Security, Law Enforcement, or military discipline

Key job responsibilities

title: Process Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Shift Description: DA5T0700
Department: IB Dock

The Amazon operations team is looking for Process Assistants with a strong record of achieving results to join the expanding team supporting operations leaders and associates in delivering strong operations results within our fulfillment centers. Process Assistants roles include production duties as needed: pick/pack orders, receive/stow product, ensure inventory accuracy, and unload/load trucks. Lead Process Assistants will also be responsible for communicating instructions to other associates, motivating them, and keeping their work areas safe.

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, Amazon has been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. Our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Things to know about working in an Amazon Fulfillment Center:
• We’re committed to providing a safe work environment. This means you wear a reflective vest, stretch and recognize others for working safely.
• We have a relaxed, casual dress code (as long as your attire meets our safety requirements).
• We work to regulate our sites as much as possible, but even with climate controls the noise and temperature levels can vary day to day. Hearing protection is available.
• You may be asked to work on a secure mezzanine at a height of up to 40 feet, or on powered equipment (forklift, cherry picker, etc.)
• You may be asked to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours, and push, pull, squat, bend and reach with or without reasonable accommodation.

For this role, you will need to be:

• At least 18 years old, and authorized to work in the United States
• Able to work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Able to lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach

Benefits include health care (medical, dental, vision) coverage starting on day 1 as well as 401(k) with company match, holiday/overtime pay and employee discount. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Has a Certificate in Operations Leadership and/or equivalent experience or training, such as the completion of a Career Choice Operations Leadership Certificate program

descriptionHtml:
Diese Rolle deckt [20:00-05:00 Uhr, FC Großkneten] ab.

Als Rezeptionist:in bist du unser freundliches Aushängeschild und sorgst in einem unserer „First Mile“-Fulfillment-Center (FC) dafür, dass Besucher und Mitarbeiter einen positiven ersten Eindruck gewinnen.
In dieser wichtigen Rolle arbeitest du mit dem Assistenten des Standortleiters (GMA) zusammen, um reibungslose Abläufe und Programme zu gewährleisten und so dazu beizutragen, ein sicheres und einladendes Arbeitsumfeld für alle zu schaffen.



Key job responsibilities
- Leitung des Empfangsbereichs und proaktive Koordination von Besprechungen mit Besuchern sowie Betreuung der Gäste
- Verwaltung der Aus- und Rückgabe verschiedener Besprechungsressourcen wie Projektoren, Flipcharts und Büromaterial 
- Koordination von Taxibuchungen und des Tracking-Systems 
- Zusammenarbeit mit dem GMA des Standorts und dem Community Ambassador zur Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Engagement-Programmen vor Ort, großen jährlichen Veranstaltungen und Amazon Community Impact-Aktivitäten
- Unterstützung bei Standort-Anerkennungsprogrammen 
- Pflege und Erstellung von Standortkommunikation, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Inhalte über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg korrekt und aktuell sind 
- Unterstützung des General Managers und des gesamten Führungsteams in der Funktion als Assistent des General Managers, um Jahresurlaub/Abwesenheiten in Abstimmung mit dem offiziellen Stellvertreter des GMA zu überbrücken 
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem GMA zur Unterstützung und Mitwirkung bei allen anfallenden administrativen Aufgaben entsprechend den Anforderungen des Standorts 
- Bearbeitung der Post und Beantwortung eingehender Anrufe, falls zutreffend
- Reisebuchungen für Mitarbeiter
- Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen über die Coupa-Beschaffungsplattform

A day in the life
In dieser Rolle arbeitest du täglich mit allen Kolleginnen und Kollegen am Standort zusammen. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung des gesamten internen und externen Postverkehrs, die Unterstützung bei der Buchung von Besprechungsräumen sowie die Beantwortung sämtlicher Anfragen von Mitarbeitenden und Besuchern. Darüber hinaus wirkst du aktiv bei Maßnahmen zur Mitarbeiterbindung und bei Anerkennungsprogrammen mit.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit der MS-Office-Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in einem professionellen Umfeld.

- Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management, im Umgang mit verschiedenen Interessengruppen auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Organisation

title: Applied Scientist II, Advertising Trust
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising operates at a scale few places in the world can match, and every ad shown to a customer must meet a high bar for trust and quality. We are looking for an Applied Scientist II to advance the machine learning systems that evaluate advertising content at scale — balancing accuracy, latency, and cost so that we protect the customer experience without slowing advertisers down. You will own meaningful scientific problems end to end: framing the problem, building and validating models, and taking them to production where they make decisions on live traffic.

This is a hands-on science role with real ownership. You will work across large multilingual datasets, modern ML and large language model techniques, and tight engineering constraints, partnering closely with other scientists, engineers, and product teams to turn research into measurable customer impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and ship ML models and systems that classify and evaluate content accurately and efficiently at scale.
- Translate ambiguous business and policy problems into well-scoped scientific problems with clear success metrics.
- Apply and adapt modern techniques — including deep learning, representation learning, and large/small language models — to production problems under real latency and cost constraints.
- Own the full model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining in response to drift and changing requirements.
- Define evaluation methodology and the metrics that matter (precision, recall, cost of error, latency), and defend trade-offs with evidence.
- Collaborate with engineering and product partners to integrate models into live systems, and mentor junior scientists.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming or scripting language like Python, Java, C or C++
- Experience in investigating, designing, prototyping, and delivering new and innovative system solutions

title: Software Dev Engineer, Pricing Shared Platform
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Shared Services team owns the core set of systems which decides prices of products sold by Amazon Retail. The team owns system data vending, notification and price publishing systems which are used by multiple pricing strategy teams for building their price recommendation and submission of their recommended prices. These systems scale to thousands of TPS and computes prices for billions of listing every month. We are building new services that radically scales publishing capacity of our systems while making our services multi-tenant to support Amazon's growing number of businesses. We collaborate with product, science, and business teams to figure out new ideas. We innovate by applying state-of-the-art computer science to define, design, and build our systems. And we experiment with different approaches, eager to learn from whatever the results are while having fun along the way.

To help meet these goals, we are looking for a passionate, talented Software Development Engineer. We are looking for someone who innovates, loves solving hard problems, and looks for 'yes' as the answer. As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop services using your expertise and experience with a variety of technologies. You will deep-dive into distributed systems to design and optimize for performance, maintainability, scalability, and extensibility. You will innovate and scale services, addressing problems that span new feature development to new system creation. You will design and write clean, maintainable code and integrate data from a large number of services. And you will contribute to the development of yourself and colleagues through peer code-reviews and mentoring, improving the technical knowledge and engineering practices of your team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features that scale and extend the Amazon Store experience on Echo Show and Fire devices.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving thoughtful feedback.
- Contribute to systems that render the Amazon store in real time, keep it in sync, and support conversational, multimodal shopping flows.
- Help extend the experience to new surfaces and international marketplaces, working through ambiguity where there is no existing playbook.
- Own your components end-to-end through livesite operations — monitoring, on-call participation, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance.
- Collaborate with engineering, science, product, and design partners across Alexa Shopping, including teammates in Seattle across time zones.
- Contribute ideas to technical designs, ask good questions, and grow your scope and autonomy over time with support from senior engineers and mentors.

About the team
You'll join Pricing Error Detection (PED), part of Amazon's Pricing Shared Services. Our job is simple to say and hard to do: make sure no customer ever sees a price that's wrong, too low for Amazon to sustain or too high for customers to trust. We review hundreds of millions of price decisions every week, before and after they go live, across Amazon's marketplaces worldwide. To do that, we build LLM-based agents that check prices against live signals from across the web, and machine learning models that judge whether each price makes sense. Together they catch errors, correct them, and stop them from happening again. If you want to put the latest GenAI to work at Amazon scale, where every decision protects both customers and the business, we'd love to talk.

descriptionHtml:
Are you seeking an environment where you can apply state-of-the-art computer science techniques, build large-scale distributed systems, and directly impact how millions of customers experience ultra-fast delivery? Do you want to build the next generation of Quick Commerce fulfillment technology from the ground up?
Amazon's Quick Commerce (QC) business is scaling rapidly across multiple cities, fulfilling hundreds of thousands of daily orders with high expansion targets. We are building a brand-new QC under-the roof-fulfillment stack on AFT foundations.
Join the QC Fulfillment Technology team and be part of developing large-scale, composable, work-cell-based systems that power our micro-stores - from inbound receiving and guided stowing to picking, staging, and last-mile handoff. These systems will be used by thousands of store associates to delight millions of customers with 10-minute delivery. In this role, the SDE will be responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable fulfillment services.
This is a true 0→1 opportunity where your code will directly impact how Quick Commerce fulfillment operates at Amazon.


Key job responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable services and APIs for the QC fulfillment stack
• Develop systems that enforce operational controls beyond Amazon sites, including external fulfillment environments with our 3P partners
• Collaborate with Senior SDEs, Principal Engineers, TPMs, and Product Managers to define technical solutions that solve fulfillment challenges at scale
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following Amazon's engineering best practices
• Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency, targeting industry-leading speeds
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical planning sessions
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the team
• Work in a fast-paced, agile environment with rapid iteration cycles, shipping new capabilities in weeks not months


About the team
We are a fast-paced and focused team of passionate Amazonians building industry-leading Quick Commerce fulfillment technology. We are standing up QC fulfillment stack that will scale beyond Amazon sites and beyond India. Our team is part of AFT, and works closely with IN Tez (QC), DEX, Speed Fulfillment teams, following a collaborative engagement model with joint workshops, and dedicated SME support.
The team values high ownership, bias for action, and insists on the highest standards while following a build-fast-and-iterate-fast methodology. We believe in speed through autonomy and safety through guardrails.
This team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to architecture and product strategy while building high-performing, scalable systems that directly impact Quick Commerce operations and Amazon Now's growth.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- • Experience working in fulfillment, logistics, or supply chain technology

title: UX Researcher, AWS Experience Analytics (EXA)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a mixed-methodology researcher to join our team. We need someone who can identify the why behind customer behaviors, uncover durable needs and motivational drivers, and work fluently with telemetry data — bringing both scientific depth and deep customer empathy. AWS customers are shifting from console-based building toward AI-augmented, agent-primary, and autonomous workflows. With this shift, a researcher will need to work with not only human customers but also agents as a new class of customer — understanding their needs and behaviors to inform the solutions we build.

You will bring creativity and a Learn and Be Curious mindset, working within the research vertical and partnering with the science and engineering teams to deliver solutions at greater scale. We move fast, and we need someone who can keep pace while maintaining a high bar for quality.

The problems are genuinely interesting — and many don't yet have established methodologies. You'll define how we study the intersection of human and agentic behavior, shaping both the questions we ask and the frameworks we use to answer them.

Key job responsibilities
Plan and conduct end-to-end mixed-methods research — from study design through synthesis — to uncover the motivations, needs, and behaviors that shape customer experience across products and services.

Translate large-scale telemetry and behavioral data into actionable insights, integrating quantitative signals with qualitative depth to build a compelling customer story.

Pioneer new research methodologies for emerging problem spaces — particularly at the intersection of human and AI-driven workflows — where established playbooks don't yet exist.

Partner cross-functionally with science and engineering teams to ensure research insights directly inform strategy and how we build our products.

Raise the bar for research quality and craft across the organization through mentorship, peer review, and thought leadership.

About the team
AWS Experience Analytics (EXA) turns customer understanding into products and intelligence that teams across AWS can use. We are building a unified customer lifecycle data platform and customer intelligence system that delivers deep customer understanding at scale to everyone across AWS. Our team approaches data both qualitatively and quantitatively, fusing customer insights with telemetry to tell actionable customer stories — insight is the critical layer that makes data meaningful.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in leading User Research projects with demonstrated impact
- Experience (end to end) with all aspects of research (study design, recruiting, moderation, analysis, reporting)
- Experience with lab-based user testing, remote testing, iterative prototype testing, survey design, and usage of multiple methods within a study
- PhD in a Social Science/Behavioral Science discipline
- 3+ years of experience conducting qualitative and quantitative research in a corporate setting
- Experience conducting B2B research
- Strong writing and communication skills
- Fluency in triangulating customer insights with telemetry data
- Have a portfolio demonstrating past work experience and deliverables (e.g., study plans, reports, personas)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in a highly Agile/Scrum environment
- Experience working with a large-scale technology platform
- Experience working with agent-supported, non-deterministic experiences
- Experience programming in Python or equivalent
- Experience with customer analytics and/or behavioral segmentation

title: Solution Architect - Manufacturing SA, Manufacturing  SA
descriptionHtml:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. The ideal candidate will posses customer facing skills that will allow them to represent Amazon well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. title: AWS Commercial Sales Internship
descriptionHtml:
The internship starts mid-April 2027 (24 weeks). You need to be enrolled in University, graduating from a Bachelor's or Master's degree in 2027 (desired) or 2028.

Mandatory languages: Swedish and English



We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will grow into the high-impact, visionary person you know you're ready to be, taking on new challenges and developing new skills every day in our AI-first cloud environment.

Would you like to be part of a team that helps customers across EMEA adopt AWS cloud solutions and accelerate their digital transformation.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, AWS is developing the next generation of commercial leaders. Our Commercial Sales Internship Program offers a structured roadmap of in-depth learning and hands-on practice across AWS services and solution selling, preparing you for a future Sales role while you deliver long-term impact through a real business project.

AWS offers a dynamic and motivating environment where you will advance your career, support the growth of AWS customers, and help shape the future of emerging cloud and AI technologies. As you build customer-readiness, the role becomes partly external-facing, giving you real exposure to customers.

This paid internship gives you the chance to take on a real business project, developed in a team connected to Amazon Global Sales. You'll work with a range of stakeholders across AWS, making a tangible impact and building and innovating in the Amazonian way. Throughout, you'll be supported by our EMEA internship community, working in agile teams with access to mentoring, learning, and shadowing opportunities.

Key job responsibilities

• Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach
• Digital innovation mindset with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging cloud technologies

• Competitive pay

Please note that this selection process is subject to change and may vary depending on the role and location.

With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

title: Software Development Engineer, Sports Data Platform - Prime Video Sports
descriptionHtml:
What if you could build the systems that tell millions of sports fans exactly when something incredible just happened in a live game? That's the kind of problem you'll solve here.

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer in Bangalore, India, to join a team that powers real time sports experiences for one of the world's largest streaming platforms. You'll work across three high impact areas that directly shape how customers discover and engage with live sports content globally.

Key job responsibilities
You'll design and build systems that deliver real time notifications to fans during live sporting events. Think score updates, close game alerts, and live activity feeds across multiple devices. You'll work with real time data pipelines that process live sports signals and make decisions about what to send, when, and to whom, all at global scale with low latency requirements.

You'll build and improve the data matching platform that connects structured sports data (leagues, teams, players, tournaments) to the content catalog. This is the foundation that powers accurate content placement, search, and personalized recommendations for customers across 240+ countries and territories.

A day in the life
You'll own the design, implementation, and operation of distributed systems that handle high throughput, real time data. You'll write clean, maintainable code, participate in design reviews, and drive engineering best practices. You'll collaborate with product managers, designers, and partner engineering teams across time zones to define requirements and deliver solutions to ambiguous problems.

This is a chance to work on systems where your code has immediate, visible impact. When a last minute goal is scored and millions of fans get notified within seconds, that's your system at work. The problem space is technically rich: real time event processing, entity resolution at scale, and intelligent notification delivery across a global customer base.

Sports on streaming is growing fast, and the engineering challenges here are genuinely interesting. You'll have the opportunity to shape technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions, and see your work come alive on game day.

If you enjoy building low latency, high scale systems and want your work to directly delight customers in real time, we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant - Migrations, Cloud Platform and Migrations, AWS Professional Services

title: Sr.Software Dev Engineer, DDB Index and Search
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB Search and Indexing


Amazon DynamoDB is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help build two new initiatives: native vector, full-text, and hybrid search; and Krupa, which aims to provide strongly consistent global secondary indexes (GSIs). These initiatives expand how customers access operational data—from finding semantically relevant results to querying current data through alternate keys.

You will work on problems at the intersection of database internals, distributed systems, information retrieval, and consistency protocols. This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational architecture, write performance-critical software, and lead engineering work across multiple DynamoDB components.

Search introduces a new set of indexing and retrieval challenges. How do you organize high-dimensional vectors across a partitioned dataset? Combine approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval with selective attribute filters? Rank results that mix semantic similarity and keyword relevance? You will help build the infrastructure behind these capabilities, including vector and inverted indexes, distributed query execution, and hybrid ranking. Your designs will balance recall, relevance, latency, freshness, and cost while the underlying data changes continuously.

Krupa addresses a different foundational problem: strongly consistent access through GSIs. Asynchronous index propagation creates a gap between a successful table write and its visibility in an index. Closing that gap requires reasoning about updates across independently partitioned table and index data, concurrent operations, transaction interactions, and partial failures. You will help design and implement the mechanisms that preserve these guarantees through retries, recovery, and changes in partition ownership.

Across these initiatives, the engineering challenge extends through the entire index lifecycle. Indexes must be built over existing data while writes continue, maintained as workloads evolve, and recovered when machines fail. You will work closely with engineers across storage, replication, transactions, routing, and the control plane to make these capabilities correct, performant, and operable.

As an SDE III, you will own significant technical decisions and carry them through implementation, validation, launch, and production operation. You will lead designs spanning component boundaries, identify risks early, and create interfaces and implementation plans that enable other engineers to deliver independently. This is an opportunity to combine deep systems engineering with technical leadership on new DynamoDB capabilities.





Key job responsibilities

- Own architecture and implementation. Lead substantial work across search and indexing, translating ambiguous requirements into precise designs, working software, and measurable customer outcomes.
- Build vector and text retrieval infrastructure. Develop vector indexing, approximate nearest-neighbor search, inverted indexes, text analysis, and relevance scoring.
- Deliver distributed search execution.Design partition selection, query fan-out, filter execution, candidate retrieval, top-k merging, and hybrid ranking using techniques such as rank fusion or reranking.
- Develop strongly consistent indexing mechanisms. Design and implement coordination between table mutations and index visibility, including concurrent updates, index-key changes, retries, and failure recovery.
- Build the index lifecycle. Deliver online creation, backfill, incremental maintenance, compaction, rebalancing, and deletion while customer traffic continues.
- Make guarantees testable. Define correctness invariants and search-quality criteria; build concurrency tests, failure-injection scenarios, and benchmarks that expose architectural weaknesses.
- Optimize the complete system. Investigate CPU, memory, storage, and network bottlenecks; quantify tradeoffs among retrieval quality, coordination overhead, write amplification, throughput, and tail latency.
- Lead across teams. Resolve design questions with partner teams, define clear contracts, and drive changes that span storage, replication, transactions, and query processing.
- Raise engineering capability. Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and break complex work into independently deliverable pieces with clear testing and rollout plans.
- Own production outcomes. Build diagnostics and recovery mechanisms, participate in operations, and use production evidence to improve architecture and reliability.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience, or Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science or equivalent
- Experience leading the design or architecture of distributed systems, databases, search infrastructure, storage engines, or comparable data platforms.

title: TEMPEST Security Specialist, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a TEMPEST Engineer to protect the classified space and systems that a U.S. Government AI Factory program depends on.

Emanations security sits on the critical path for accreditation, and we need someone who can both run the test and own the program behind it. You will plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis, then develop and maintain the TEMPEST program and documentation that carries those results into the accreditation package. You will verify RED/BLACK separation and TEMPEST countermeasures and work directly with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority. Partnering with physical security, construction security specialists, systems engineers, and our Government counterparts, you will take classified space and equipment from design to accredited, and keep it that way.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
- Plan and perform instrumented TEMPEST/EMSEC testing and signal analysis on classified systems and facilities; set up test equipment, take measurements, record findings, and produce test reports.
- Identify compromising-emanation vulnerabilities and recommend, implement, and verify TEMPEST countermeasures and mitigations.
- Develop and maintain the TEMPEST program, TEMPEST Checklist, and emanations-security test documentation in support of the ICD 705 accreditation package.
- Verify RED/BLACK equipment and cabling separation and installation against CNSSAM TEMPEST/01-13 and related standards.
- Coordinate with the certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and the Government accreditation authority on TEMPEST requirements, countermeasure reviews, and findings.
- Track TEMPEST testing status, findings, and retest and reaccreditation actions.
- Collaborate with internal teams, general contractors, architects, and engineers prior to and during facility builds to ensure emanations-security requirements are captured and met.
- Read and understand construction details and drawings that capture Government TEMPEST and RED/BLACK requirements and standards.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, because classified space moves through phases and so do you. One morning you are on site with test equipment, taking instrumented emanations measurements and analyzing signals; that afternoon you are writing up findings and updating the TEMPEST Checklist and accreditation documentation. Some days you are walking a build with construction security specialists and engineers, confirming RED/BLACK separation against the drawings before walls close. Others you are on the phone with the CTTA and the Government accreditation authority, working countermeasure reviews and closing out findings. You move fluidly between the bench and the program, and you are the person who makes sure the emanations-security details are right so accreditation stays on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in TEMPEST, EMSEC, or technical emanations security.
- Working knowledge of TEMPEST and RED/BLACK installation standards (for example NSTISSAM TEMPEST/1-92, CNSSAM TEMPEST/01-13, CNSSP-510).
- Current, active US Government TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on instrumented TEMPEST test experience: test equipment setup, measurement, and signal analysis.
- Experience coordinating with a certified TEMPEST technical authority (CTTA) and a Government accreditation authority.
- Experience developing TEMPEST Checklists, test plans, and emanations-security documentation for an ICD 705 accreditation package.
- Knowledge of ICD 705 as it relates to TEMPEST and construction security.
- ICD 705 practitioner training, and/or a formal TEMPEST or EMSEC training certificate.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, OTS COST, Ops Tech Solutions Delivery
descriptionHtml:
The COST (Cost Optimization, Strategy, and Technology) team within Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) Delivery is seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer to build and own the data products behind its cost work. The COST team delivers cost visibility, savings governance, and free cash flow improvement across a global RME and IT Operations cost base.

Within COST, our team finds savings opportunities, checks whether savings are real, and gives leaders the cost reporting and comparisons they use to make decisions.

You will work with program managers and leaders who use your work to make cost decisions. You take data from our shared data platform and turn it into dashboards, datasets and analysis that people can trust. We use generative AI day to day, alongside SQL and dashboards.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and own dashboards, datasets and reporting that leaders use to understand and manage cost
- Analyze spend data to find trends, anomalies and savings opportunities, and explain what you find to non-technical audiences
- Build the data and checks that show whether savings have actually been delivered
- Automate the team's own manual work, including with generative AI tools, so program managers spend less time on reporting
- Work to the team's priorities, and say early when you think a different piece of work would matter more
- Validate your outputs against source data and business logic, and fix issues at the cause
- Document your products so others on the team can run them
- Work with engineering partners on data sources and data quality

A day in the life
No two days are the same. You might check a data refresh, work with a program manager on whether a spend change is a real cost signal, build a new view for a leadership review, or work through a data issue with an engineering partner. Travel up to 10%.

About the team
We are a small team of program managers and BI, based in Europe and part of OTS Delivery. We work closely with the team that owns our data platform and delivers technical programs, and we document our work so anyone on the team can pick it up.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
- Experience with SQL
- Experience building and maintaining basic data artifacts (e.g., ETL, data models, queries)

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis
- Knowledge of how to improve code quality and optimizes BI processes (e.g. speed, cost, reliability)

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking to hire a highly motivated, customer-obsessed professional to provide hands-on support to our Data Center Infrastructure Operations team in Berlin.

As a Data Center Security Manager (DSM), you will be tasked with running day-to-day data center security operations, supporting and executing security projects and programs, as well as assuring audit compliance with AWS policies and procedures. This includes:
• Direct and manage contract guard force to run daily data center operations

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
