title: Senior HR Partner — Amazon Leo, Production Operations
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever wanted to be part of a team building industry-changing technology? At Amazon Leo, we're building a low Earth orbit satellite network that will deliver broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world — with customers like Delta Airlines, JetBlue, and AT&T already committed ahead of commercial launch. Behind that mission is a manufacturing operation scaling fast, and we need a senior HR leader on the ground to help our people keep pace.

We're hiring a Senior Human Resources Partner (HRP) to be the face of HR at one of Leo's Puget Sound manufacturing site clusters. This is a strategic L6 individual contributor role in the PXT (People eXperience and Technology) organization — part site strategist, part culture builder, part operational backbone.

You'll own the people strategy for your sites end to end. That means shaping employee sentiment, strengthening manager capability, building out hourly HR infrastructure, and making sure floor coverage runs smoothly every day. You'll partner closely with a pod of HRPs, serve as the go-to partner for site leadership, and turn org-wide priorities into actions employees actually feel. You'll report to the Sr. HRP Manager while working in close strategic partnership with the Leo Production Operations Site HRP Manager to keep day-to-day operations aligned across your sites.

This role is about staying ahead, not reacting. You'll spend time on the floor doing Gemba and floor walks, listening to employees, and using sentiment data to spot issues early and drive culture improvements that last. The right person leads through influence, not authority, and moves naturally between big-picture thinking and getting things done.

This is an on-site position based at SEA99 in Redmond, WA, working Monday through Friday, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM PST, with the ability to flex to 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST as needed. Flexibility to adjust hours and availability for escalations on a rotational basis is expected. Periodic travel to other Leo ProdOps facilities across the Puget Sound (Redmond, Kirkland, Everett) is part of the job.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the people strategy for your site cluster end to end. You're the senior HRP on the ground and the first call for site leadership.
- Guide a pod of site HRPs without formal authority. Coordinate coverage across shifts, keep the team aligned on priorities, and drive knowledge sharing so nothing falls through the cracks on the floor.
- Stay ahead through floor presence and data. Conduct regular Gemba walks, use sentiment data and listening mechanisms to spot issues early, and work with site leaders to act before problems take root.
- Bridge site operations and org strategy. Partner with the Sr. HRP Manager and Site HRP Manager to align priorities, flag emerging risks, and translate big-picture direction into action your sites can feel. Work across HRBPs, Employee Relations, Labor Relations to execute site-specific programs.
- Consult on the hardest people topics and handle escalations. Advise site leadership on talent, performance, compensation, among other things. Run workplace investigations with discretion, applying Amazon policies and high judgment as the first point of escalation for complex concerns.
- Build better leaders and drive culture. Coach site managers to sharpen their decision-making, strengthen their teams, and own culture on the floor. Set goals with leaders, build action plans, and track progress as the business evolves.
- Simplify the employee experience and lead change. Develop and improve PXT programs for hourly employees, find opportunities to standardize, and own change management — communication, stakeholder engagement, and adoption — so new processes actually land.
- Influence beyond your sites. Collaborate with central HR teams to improve processes, shape product development, and build mechanisms that scale. This role is a proving ground for future people leadership — demonstrate readiness through how you influence, coordinate, and deliver results.

title: Procurement Category Manager, OneMHS Procurement & Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model has been to allow each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. While that has allowed Amazon to be successful to this point, the variability between buildings has proven difficult to support and scale. One MHS’ charge is to build partnerships to focus on consistency and scalability across our network of the future. We will be partnering with key suppliers to help them scale up their manufacturing capabilities to keep up with our needs, as well as refining their designs to drive innovation and operational uptime and better meet the specific needs of Amazon’s operational environment. In partnership with WWDE, OMHS will challenge the status quo on our Gen14 AR sortables building by focusing on critical equipment, controls, and system implementation methods. We are seeking a Procurement Category Manager (PCM) to join our One-MHS team & to partner with internal business owners and key stakeholders across One-MHS & partner organizations, to drive procurement and operational value for these MHE systems. This role creates and executes of capital sourcing strategies for equipment, devices and/or services required to install MHE systems. Our PCM drive efficiencies in procurement strategy and commercial pricing, enable engineering efficiencies through effective partnership with Amazon’s design teams, and support Amazon’s long-term business interests through partnership within One-MHS teams as well as other teams like GPO, Capital Planning, Project Management Organization (PMO), Worldwide Design Engineering (WWDE), Finance, Global Engineering Services (GES) Operations Engineering (Ops Eng.), and Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME).

title: Applied Scientist, AWS Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Most AI assistants today start every conversation from scratch, forgetting what they learned yesterday about developer's codebase, patterns, and the way they like to work. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of scientists and engineers to change that, and we are hiring an Applied Scientist to build the systems that let our AI development tools accumulate knowledge over time and get genuinely better the more you use them. You will help create generative AI technologies, including Kiro IDE and CLI, that are transforming how software gets built.

You will take on some of the hardest open problems in machine learning: how a model keeps learning without forgetting what it already knew, how to store and retrieve the right memory at the right moment, and how to personalize the experience for each developer and team without starting over every time. Your work will reach millions of developers rather than sit in a paper, and you will own a research direction end to end rather than share a sliver of attention across many priorities.

Key job responsibilities
- Push the boundaries of continual and lifelong learning for large language models specialized in code intelligence
- Design memory-augmented architectures and retrieval mechanisms that let the assistant consolidate, recall, and personalize knowledge over time
- Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale
- Deploy products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
- Publish and present your work at premier ML and NLP conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP)

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to shape the quality of a product that connects customers to the internet across the globe? Amazon's Leo ecommerce team is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer II to own the frontend quality of the Leo website — the destination where customers discover, purchase, and manage their internet service. In this role, you will build test strategies and Playwright automation for a product that is actively expanding into new countries, giving you the chance to define scalable testing practices from the ground up. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers, and software developers to catch issues early, surface missed use cases during grooming, and raise the quality bar so that every feature meets customer expectations before it ever reaches production.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end testing of the Leo ecommerce frontend experience, creating and executing test plans that cover functional, integration, and regression scenarios across multiple country launches.
- Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, evaluate coverage ROI, and define strategies for when and what to automate — partnering with the development team to expand automation over time.
- Participate in product grooming sessions alongside product managers and UX designers, providing the QA perspective to identify edge cases, clarify acceptance criteria, and flag risks before development begins.
- Triage and prioritize bugs, perform root cause analysis, and drive defect resolution to reduce the number of issues that reach production.
- Own testing runbooks and QA documentation for the team, ensuring processes are repeatable and scalable as the product grows into new markets.

A day in the life
You will start many mornings reviewing incoming bug tickets and prioritizing what needs attention, then shift into proactive work — writing test plans for upcoming features or extending Playwright automation. Expect to spend a good portion of your week in collaborative sessions with UX designers, developers, and product managers during grooming and sprint ceremonies, where your input directly shapes what gets built and how. Between those sessions, you will have heads-down time to execute tests, refine runbooks, and analyze quality metrics. This is an independent, self-directed role where you decide where your attention has the most impact.

About the team
The Leo ecommerce team builds and operates the website where customers learn about, purchase, and manage their Amazon internet service. As Leo expands into new countries, the team is investing in scalable processes and automation to keep pace with growth. You will join a collaborative group of developers, product managers, and UX designers who value clear communication and a shared commitment to getting the details right. This is a great opportunity to build expertise in commerce at scale, international expansion, and modern test automation in the age of AI.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in automation testing
- Experience in manual testing
- Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- +2 years working with modern test automation frameworks like Playwright

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience with performance and scalability testing
- Experience working closely with development and business teams to communicate problem impacts and to understand business requirements

title: Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for independently managing difficult, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — supporting Amazon's logistics network infrastructure.

You work independently within your assigned region, using your knowledge of construction and project management concepts to decide which actions to take to complete projects, and seeking guidance as needed on strategic components. You are tactical with some strategic components, utilizing well-defined processes and best practices to facilitate delivery of high-quality results. You make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to keep projects on track.

Key competencies of this position include ensuring that contracted resources deliver work product in support of project durations, permitting, key performance indicators (KPIs), and quality documentation; managing project teams (developers, design engineers, professional consultants); influencing internal teams (Design Engineering, Amazon Robotics); contract management governance; conceptual estimating and budget oversight; and managing multiple large industrial projects in various locations simultaneously. Translating technical documents and information into clear, concise narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers is essential.

This opportunity combines construction engineering, planning, project management, real estate development, design validation, site visits, understanding of local building and fire code issues, utilities, sustainability, multi-disciplinary design management, and contract management. The Preconstruction Manager is responsible for the planning and design of scope, budget, and schedule prior to handing off to the Construction Manager — focusing on taking ownership to resolve upstream issues and supporting the construction team throughout the process.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Supervise the implementation and management of Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases of a project
- Interface and coordinate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Independently manage difficult, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — coordinating with design teams to develop site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and escalating appropriately
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability
- Minimize disruptions and proactively mitigate risks; plan ahead to prevent problems before they happen

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Develop and manage project budgets and costs; own comprehensive schedule management and cashflow forecasting across assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; negotiate the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Contribute to the selection of external vendor partners and manage vendor procurement; oversee professional service providers to ensure their skills and competencies meet project requirements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; competently represent project and technical information to diverse audiences
- Maintain good working relationships with stakeholders and vendors; lead constructive dialogue to resolve and prevent project issues
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved

Communication & Reporting
- Prepare and present project status and risk reports; provide clear, concise summaries for projects under your ownership to leadership and management teams
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end narratives with detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, checking progress, and driving high-level alignment and consensus
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners; trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 2-3 tiers above level
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement & Innovation
- Optimize preconstruction processes and implement improvements in procedures and playbooks to improve project efficiency and delivery
- Look for opportunities to improve operational excellence and influence the team to determine where to iterate and make improvements
- Seek sustainable, environmentally responsible solutions throughout the preconstruction process in alignment with Amazon's building practices
- Adapt to constant change and innovation; find adaptable solutions for an evolving business

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's owner during the preconstruction phase — navigating uncertainty, proactively unblocking project barriers, and influencing the best project decisions. You are tactical with some strategic components, working independently and interacting with leadership to resolve issues. Your day may include:
- Coordinating with architects, engineers, and design consultants on design document development, scope changes, and project status
- Reviewing site plans, composite floor plans, and design documents for compliance with Amazon's standards and operational requirements
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Preparing and presenting project status and risk reports for leadership
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Providing estimating support, interpreting drawings, contributing to budgets, and reviewing lease exhibits
- Updating Amazon's project management systems with current budget, schedule, and status information
- Supporting the Construction Manager on active construction projects with preconstruction expertise

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline

title: Transportation Representative, NOC-NL
descriptionHtml:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion.

Key job responsibilities
Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers
(Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data
management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams
who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that
make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the
relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and
identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative
outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review
forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environmen

Basic qualifications

- - Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL - Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments - 10+ 2 degree

Preferred qualifications

- - Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers - Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL- Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers - Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL

. . Coordinate utility and infrastructure requirements (power, cooling, network, compressed air) for each production zone with facilities and construction teams, ensuring infrastructure readiness aligns with layout phasing — particularly for high-density ML accelerator and Storage rack configurations requiring liquid cooling and high-power distribution

Manage phased layout plans aligned with construction milestones, enabling production in early zones while build-out continues in adjacent areas; own layout change control, produce clear visual documentation (2D/3D layouts, material flow diagrams, phasing overlays), and develop replicable standards across the global manufacturing site network

Drive continuous improvement and operations sustaining by owning the factory layout as a living document, partnering with Operations, Test, Process, and Automation Engineering teams to implement optimizations that reduce cycle time, improve throughput toward manufacturing-to-ship SLA targets, and enable rapid capacity deployment for new product platform introductions

title: Data Center Facility Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience across multiple shift schedules
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Ensure staffing levels are maintained and grow with expansions
- Be actively involved in ongoing construction activities
- Coordinate daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience

- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience conducting interviews and making effective hiring decisions

title: Clearance Processing Administrator, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Clearance Processing Administrator to build and sustain the cleared workforce for a U.S. Government program standing up a classified AI Factory. We are obsessed with getting the right people cleared, badged, and mission-effective as fast as the rules allow, because clearance throughput is the single biggest driver of whether this program starts on time. In this role you own personnel clearance processing end to end: submitting and tracking crossover packets and SCI access requests, verifying eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and coordinating adjudications and access determinations with our sponsoring security office. You will work in the trenches with personnel security, program security officers, and hiring managers to turn a 120-plus person staffing plan into people who can actually walk into the SCIF and work. If you thrive on high-volume, high-stakes personnel security, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Submit and track clearance crossover packets and SCI access requests (e.g., via the Government clearance-submission system).
• Verify eligibility, citizenship, SSBI/CIP currency, and need-to-know prior to access.
• Coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and access determinations.
• Maintain the personnel-security database and access records, and remove access when no longer required.

A day in the life
Each day starts with the clearance queue. You triage incoming crossover packets and SCI access requests, verify eligibility, citizenship, and investigation currency, and push the cleanest cases forward first to keep throughput high. You coordinate with the sponsoring security office on adjudications and pending access determinations, chase down the one missing document holding up a start date, and update the personnel-security database so records stay audit-ready. title: Principal Product Designer, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Do you want your design work to decide what gets built, rather than describe it afterward?

Amazon builds artificial intelligence systems that scientists and clinicians use to discover new medicines and run clinical trials. Better software here has an unusually direct consequence: therapies reach patients sooner, and scientists spend their time on science.

You will own the end-to-end user experience point of view across that portfolio — from regulated clinical research through computational drug discovery — defining how a scientist works alongside an artificial intelligence teammate rather than operating a tool and proving it with working prototypes that become the specification engineering leverages to build.

Key job responsibilities
Own and defend the user experience point of view across the portfolio, working as a peer to product management, applied science, engineering and architecture rather than downstream of finished requirements.

Define the interaction model for software that acts on a person's behalf — how it shows its evidence, where the person keeps control, what it does when it is wrong, and how work is handed back.

Direct and build high-fidelity working prototypes, and use them as the shared specification that product and engineering develop against.

Mentor and develop other designers across the portfolio through mentoring and shared patterns.

A day in the life
You spend a morning with a computational biologist. She tells you the product output looks plausible and she does not trust it. This is the most consequential thing anyone will say all quarter, and the rest of your week goes into turning it into something the product does differently.

Later that week you present one working flow and three open questions to leadership, arguing that products built separately should reach a customer as one. How that lands decides what gets funded.

Another day you review a prototype of a pattern you specified.

About the team
Life Sciences, within AWS Applied AI Solutions, supports AI products for drug discovery and clinical research. Small team, large surface. Arguments are settled by building and inspecting: prototypes are the primary artifact and the engineering handoff. Regulators shape the products and how research is run, and design has carried much of the product direction, making the role load-bearing, not advisory. UX is horizontal: you succeed when a partner team ships your work. The systems behave like a capable colleague, not a tool, knowing when to act, when to ask, and how to show their work.

Basic qualifications

10+ years of experience as a practicing product or user experience designer.

Experience designing data-dense enterprise, scientific or technical software.

Experience owning design direction for multiple products or a product portfolio simultaneously.

Experience designing products built on large language models or multi-step automated agents, including how such a system behaves when it fails.

Experience designing for regulated clinical research, drug discovery, or an equivalently regulated scientific domain.

Experience building high-fidelity interactive prototypes.

Experience presenting design work to senior business leadership.

Bachelor's degree, or 10 years of professional design experience in lieu of a degree.

Preferred qualifications

Experience in both regulated clinical research and drug discovery, with the ability to move between those audiences without a translator.

Experience partnering with machine learning or applied science teams on model behavior and evaluation.

Experience designing for reproducible analysis, traceable evidence and visible uncertainty, where a convincing output is not the same as a valid result.

Familiarity with computational protein or antibody design tooling, or with clinical data standards for study data, analysis data and reporting outputs.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

descriptionHtml:
Do you want to change how the world's largest organizations give their people, and now their AI agents, a secure place to work? The Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) team is hiring a Specialist Solutions Architecture Leader for Agentic WorkSpaces. You'll lead the Americas Specialist SA team supporting AWS Industries (AWSI) and Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) customers.

Agentic WorkSpaces includes Amazon WorkSpaces (Personal, Pools and Core), WorkSpaces Applications, WorkSpaces Secure Browser, WorkSpaces Thin Client, and new capabilities that let AI agents work securely next to human users on managed desktops. Our customers are moving off legacy on-premises VDI, modernizing how they deliver end-user computing, and starting to run agentic workloads in production. Your team will be the technical lead for those moves.

In this role you'll hire, develop and lead a team of Specialist SAs who work with enterprise, regulated-industry, and government customers on their hardest EUC and agentic desktop problems. You'll work closely with Specialist Sellers, account teams, Professional Services, Partners and the WorkSpaces service team to grow adoption, unblock deals, and bring field feedback into the product roadmap. You'll also be expected to stay hands-on enough to step in on strategic engagements yourself.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead, hire and develop a team of Specialist SAs across the Americas, aligned to AWSI and WWPS. Set a high bar for technical depth, customer obsession, and ownership.
- Own the technical strategy for Agentic WorkSpaces adoption in your segments, including VDI migrations (Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon and others), net-new EUC deployments, and early agentic workloads.
- Partner with Specialist Sales leaders to build and progress pipeline, run deal reviews, and drive revenue and adoption goals.
- Act as an executive-level technical advisor to strategic customers. Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and security and compliance discussions (FedRAMP, GovCloud, ADC, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, CJIS).
- Build scalable programs with Partners and SIs so migrations and deployments can grow beyond what the SA team can cover directly.
- Represent the voice of the customer to the WorkSpaces product and engineering teams. Turn field feedback into prioritized feature requests, regional expansion asks, and roadmap input.
- Build scalable technical content (reference architectures, workshops, demos, blogs, re:Invent and Summit sessions) to grow the AWS field and partner community.
- Run operating mechanisms for your team (WBR/MBR inputs, SpecReq SLAs, activity and impact reporting) and work with your peer SA leaders across EMEA and APJ so the global team runs consistently.

A day in the life
You might start your morning in a 1:1 with one of your SAs, then join a federal agency's CIO to walk through their move off on-premises VDI. After lunch you could be in a deal review with your Specialist Sales partner, then talking through a feature gap with the product team that's blocking a large healthcare customer. You'll end the day reviewing a reference architecture your team is publishing for agent-enabled desktops. Expect regular travel to customers, partners and AWS events.

Applied AI Solutions builds and takes to market AWS's applied AI products, including Amazon Connect and Agentic WorkSpaces. Our Specialist SA organization covers customers worldwide, and we care a lot about mentorship, inclusion, and helping people grow into their next role.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Aircraft Maintenance Operations Manager, Amazon Air
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to lead the transformation of aircraft maintenance operations through Generative AI and emerging technology?

Join Amazon AIR's Network Control Center Maintenance Operations team (MXO) and shape the future of how a global fleet is maintained, optimized, and scaled.

Amazon AIR is seeking a Senior Aircraft Maintenance Operations Manager to drive operational excellence at the intersection of aviation expertise, AI/ML innovation, and data-driven strategy. In this role, you won't just manage maintenance operations, you'll architect the next generation of tools, processes, and best practices that keep Amazon's air network moving safely and efficiently. The Maintenance Operations team (MXO) is rapidly evolving, incorporating GenAI-powered analytics, real-time fleet health monitoring, and intelligent automation to move from reactive maintenance to predictive, insight-driven operations.

This is a rare opportunity to lead — not just use — AI-enabled transformation in aviation maintenance at global scale.

This role supports Amazon Air's 24/7 Network Control Center. Flexibility to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, may be required as business needs evolve.

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee daily maintenance operations workflow, ensuring effective communication and coordination between maintenance providers and network operations
- Manage real-time operational decisions regarding maintenance events, aircraft swaps, and recovery scenarios to minimize network disruption and maintain schedule integrity
- Develop and drive real-time fleet health monitoring strategies and technical readiness assessments for the Amazon Air global fleet
- Drive implementation of AI/ML technologies to enhance operational maintenance strategies, leveraging GenAI tools to synthesize data and surface actionable insights
- Serve as primary contact for maintenance-related communications, developing protocols to manage service impacts and customer experience
- Create data-driven strategies to maximize maintenance On-Time Performance
- Develop and document lessons learned to continually improve maintenance operations across the network
- Champion adoption of approved AI solutions within daily workflows — evaluating emerging tools, leading pilot efforts, and providing feedback that shapes continuous process improvement

A day in the life
Your day starts with the state of the fleet: reviewing aircraft health, open maintenance events, and anything that could affect the day's flying. During disruptions, you give the NCC a clear technical picture and workable options so the network can recover quickly, and you keep carrier Maintenance Control teams and maintenance providers aligned on the plan.

Most of your time, though, goes to the problems no one has solved yet. You might be asked why a recurring delay keeps showing up across stations, or how to spot a failure trend before it grounds an aircraft. These questions rarely come with a playbook. You'll define the problem, decide which data and tools can answer it, and use the GenAI and analytics tools available at MXO to move from question to working solution faster than traditional methods allow. When something works, you turn it into a repeatable process and share it so the whole team operates at a higher level.

About the team
The Maintenance Operations team (MXO) is a team of 11 within Amazon Air's Network Control Center (NCC), the 24/7 operations hub for a network of more than 100 aircraft serving over 70 airports across North America, Europe, and Asia. Team members bring
experience from airline maintenance control, line maintenance and MRO leadership, and military aviation. MXO connects our carrier partners' Maintenance Control teams and external maintenance providers with network operations. When an aircraft has a
maintenance issue, MXO gives the NCC the technical status, options, and timelines it needs to decide how the network responds, then keeps maintenance partners and stakeholders aligned through recovery.

Beyond daily operations, MXO is moving maintenance from reactive to predictive by adopting real-time fleet health monitoring, GenAI-powered analytics, and intelligent automation.

We look for sound technical judgment under pressure and people who leave a process better than they found it.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years Airline, military, or equivalent experience with 14CFR 121 operations in line maintenance, maintenance control, heavy maintenance or equivalent
- FAA Part 65 Airframe and Powerplant certificate or equivalent.
- Experience with data analytics and technology implementation in aviation

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using data and metrics to drive actionable insights at scale
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- 5+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Background in aircraft maintenance control and line maintenance operations
- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and their potential in maintenance forecasting

title: Electrical Install SME, One MHS
descriptionHtml:
OMHS Integration & Deployment is building the team that installs and commissions Amazon's next-generation material handling systems. We are looking for an electrical installation subject matter expert for our installation programs, providing technical leadership across the full portfolio of equipment.

If you have spent your career installing or maintaining electrical systems on industrial equipment, you know exactly which wiring shortcuts, grounding omissions, and termination errors cause the failures maintenance teams live with for years. This role puts that knowledge at the front of the equipment lifecycle. You will develop the installation job plans that define how Amazon's material handling equipment gets wired, terminated, grounded, and energized, preventing reliability and safety problems before the equipment ever runs its first package.

You will own electrical installation quality end-to-end: authoring installation job plans and standards, validating contractor execution against them, and driving continuous improvement as system complexity scales.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop installation job plans for MHE electrical systems, translating equipment expertise into task-level installation procedures and acceptance criteria
• Author and maintain electrical installation standards and pre-turnover punch list criteria for all OMHS equipment types, ensuring alignment with industry and Amazon-specific requirements
• Apply failure mode knowledge from equipment service history to identify the installation practices that drive long-term electrical reliability, and build them into job plans
• Audit electrical installation work in the field and identify deficiencies, document findings, and drive corrective action to closure
• Partner with site installation teams to interpret electrical drawings, resolve field routing and termination issues, and validate compliance with specifications and code requirements
• Collaborate with the rest of the team to create integrated system acceptance packages
• Analyze early-life electrical failures to identify systemic installation quality gaps and feed corrections back into job plans and standards
• Create training content for field supervisors and installation crews on electrical installation quality expectations and code compliance.
• Represent OMHS I&D in cross-functional forums with Design Engineering, RME, and Construction on electrical installation best practices and standards compliance

Basic qualifications

- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services' Cloud Storage, Amazon S3, is one of the largest distributed storage systems in the world, hosting trillions of objects and serving hundreds of millions of requests per second - and we're continuing to grow! In this role, you will leverage your technical depth in large-scale distributed systems to solve complex problems with simple solutions for one of AWS's foundational services. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at massive scale while building both great software and great teams.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the design, delivery & operations of select services which form part of the S3 Index Control Plane system. These services monitor, scale & repair the data plane services on request path for GET, PUT, LIST & DELETE API verbs
- Lead and mentor a team of talented software engineers, creating structures that enable them to solve complex problems and deliver high-impact solutions while fostering their growth and professional development.
- Own team-wide architectural decisions and technical direction for a high-visibility components of S3, ensuring quality software aligned with Amazon's engineering best practices while making appropriate trade-offs between tactical needs and strategic goals.
- Create mechanisms and metrics that enable you to explain your team's performance and identify opportunities to improve customer experiences.
- Partner with engineering leaders across S3 to identify and address complex technical challenges, evaluating downstream impacts and architectural cohesiveness.

A day in the life
You'll start your day collaborating with your team of talented software engineers, finding a balance between planned priorities & emerging operational events. Throughout the day, you'll balance technical deep dives with strategic planning sessions, working with your peers on S3 Index or across the broader S3 organization. You'll mentor team members to foster their growth while ensuring they have the support needed to deliver complex solutions that meet S3's rigorous standards for security, durability, availability, and performance.

About the team
As a Manager on S3 Index Control Plane, you will lead a team of Engineer’s working on services that are central to the success of the overall S3 business. 'S3 Index' serves as the metadata storage for objects persisted in S3. 'S3 Index Control Plane' designs, builds & operates the services which monitor, scale and repair the request path systems of S3 Index. Index Control Plane team delivers for customers by ensuring data durability, external API availability and mitigating 503s (throttling) by repairing or scaling the customer key space across Index request path systems. S3 Index is responsive to historical and near real-time customer usage patterns when scaling for throughput. Index Control Plane services balance and distribute load across a large fleet of global services ensuring that compute, memory and storage capacity is not under-utilized or over allocated.

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI or higher.

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for well-understood problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.


Key job responsibilities
• Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
• Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
• Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
• Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
• Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.


A day in the life
An FDE II spends the day building inside the customer's environment: pairing with their engineers on production AI features, translating requirements into designs for their workstream, troubleshooting production issues, and reviewing code. They work autonomously on scoped problems, bringing clarity to ambiguous implementations with appropriate guidance from senior FDEs.

title: Construction Manager, Facility Design & Construction, FSOE, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
Job Summary
本ポジションでは、ラストマイルの物流拠点であるDelivery Station（DS）およびSub Same Day（SSD）の新規開所プロジェクトを主導するエンジニアを募集しています。建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火設備の多分野にわたる設計施工監理を総合的に担い、発注者の立場でプロジェクトの安全管理・工程管理・コスト管理を遂行します。年間複数拠点の同時立ち上げにおいて、各プロジェクトの設計品質と短工期の両立を図りながら、竣工・引き渡しまで一貫してリードします。安全管理では、工事請負業者が各種法令およびAmazonの工事安全基準を遵守できるよう、作業計画段階でのリスクアセスメントから工事期間中の安全パトロールまで一連の安全活動を推進します。万一の事故・災害発生時には再発防止策を立案し、工事安全基準へ反映します。工程管理・コスト管理では、複数の専門工事業者間の全体工程を調整し、コスト交渉を主導して予算内での竣工を実現します。さらに、過去のプロジェクト実績やデータを活用し、設計仕様・施工プロセスの標準化や簡素化を自ら提案・推進することで、拠点展開のスピードとコスト効率を継続的に改善します。社内の関連部門（オペレーション、調達、安全衛生等）と連携しながら、部署全体のプロジェクト推進力の向上に貢献します。

職務記述（内容、責任、遂行要件、他職務との関係等）
70% ― DS・SSD新規開所の設計施工監理
・テナント物件の現地調査・設計要件の整理から、基本設計・実施設計のレビュー、施工監理、竣工検査・引き渡し
・建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火設備の各専門工事業者との工程調整およびコスト交渉
・工事請負業者に対する安全管理（リスクアセスメント、安全パトロール、是正指示）
15% ― 設計仕様・施工プロセス・安全管理の標準化
・DS・SSD向け設計標準（建屋仕様・設備仕様）の策定・改定
・施工プロセスや安全管理手順の標準化・ドキュメント整備
15% ― 予算管理・コスト最適化
・プロジェクト予算の策定・実績管理・差異分析
・VE（バリューエンジニアリング）提案によるコスト削減施策の立案・実行

Related information
・所属部門:オペレーション技術開発
・職種:エンジニア
・勤務地:東京オフィス
・オペレーション技術開発部門の社員インタビューはこちら
・エンジニア職の社員インタビュー
オペレーション技術開発(JCFS)部門/東京オフィス勤務の社員S.U.さん
オペレーション技術開発(JCFS)部門/関東DS勤務の社員M.U.さん

Amazonは多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp

Key job responsibilities
DSおよびSSDの新規開所プロジェクトにおいて、建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火設備の複合的な設計業務を行い、工事フェーズでは常に安全を最優先し計画通りにプロジェクトを完了させます。同時に複数のプロジェクトを担当することもあり、社内外および海外の関係者と協力し円滑にプロジェクトを進めます。優れたコミュニケーション能力と、折衝力を持ち合わせていることが求められます。

A day in the life
DSおよびSSDの新規開所プロジェクトを担当していただきます。計画フェーズでは、自身の担当プロジェクトの実施承認を得るために、ソリューション提案、コスト、スケジュールなどの計画をまとめます。工事フェーズでは自ら現場で管理を行い、計画通り進捗しているか確認します。部内定例ミーティングとチームミーティングがそれぞれ週1回開催されており、そこで情報共有やチームビルドを図っています。出張など所属サイト以外での勤務は平均すると週1回程度あり、遠隔地の場合は宿泊を伴う出張もあります。フレックス勤務を導入し、個人のライフイベントを迎えながらキャリアを長期的に築いていける環境もあります。

About the team
Facility Design & Construction(建築設計・工事監理部)は、Amazonに必要な物流拠点の新規立ち上げ、また、運用中拠点の大規模な改修工事を担い、ビジネスやカスタマーに貢献するチームです。新規立ち上げでは、建物のレイアウトや建築、設備の設計を行い、プロジェクト全体の工程を守り、コスト管理を行いながら安全で生産性の高い建物を作ります。既存の改修工事では、生産性向上のための設備変更や、経年による老朽化対策の設備更新などを企画し、プロジェクトのオーナーとして品質、コスト管理しながら完了までリードします。今回の募集ポジションでは新規DS、SSDの工事を担当いただきますが、設計標準の最適化や工事管理の標準化など部内全体で行う業務にも取り組んでいただきます。

Basic qualifications

- 建築、電気、空調、衛生、防災設備についての知識や経験
- 発注者側での5年以上の工事監理経験、もしくは請負工事会社での5年以上の施工管理経験
- 諸官庁と建築基準法や消防法、その他建築・設備に関わる法規に関わる折衝やProjectをリードした経験

- 新築現場で受注金額が10億円以上、改修工事で5億円以上の工事について現場代理人、主任技術者経験
- CADでの作図経験およびPCスキル（Auto CAD）

title: Network Deployment Build Lead (Network Technician), Global Network Deployment, AWS, AWS DC Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
WS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You'll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, and operations managers, experiencing an inclusive culture that empowers you to own bold ideas to completion.

We are looking for a highly motivated Network Technician to join Global Network Delivery (GND). This role involves delivering hardware, configuration, and fiber connectivity of scaling projects across multiple data center locations. The ideal candidate is highly autonomous, detail-oriented, with strong communication skills and significant experience supporting large-scale enterprise networks. This position works with minimum supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks.

Amazon Data Centers treat customer data with the utmost importance. All tasks must be performed in strict accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure customer data and company intellectual property is protected and properly handled.

Key job responsibilities
Working closely with Network Engineering and Network Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth rollout of established designs and products.

Managing work and priorities through ticketing systems and workflows.

Managing small to large cabling and fiber connectivity projects within the data centers.

Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles.

Troubleshooting networking, routing, interconnectivity, and cabling infrastructure issues, including patch panels and patch cords.

Specifying power and cooling requirements, hardware racking/stacking, and participating in migration, configuration, and rollout of new or upgraded equipment.

Experience dealing with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.

A day in the life
You will play a pivotal part in scaling the network of several data center locations, responsible for the physical deployment of new network infrastructure. You will manage cabling projects and deployment activities, working closely with internal customers and external vendors. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can perform repetitive tasks, adhere to standard processes, and communicate effectively across teams. Up to 20% of travel may be required, including possible international travel.

About the team
Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse & Inclusive Culture

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have employee-led affinity groups that foster a culture of inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply — even if your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Mentorship, Career Growth & Work-Life Harmony

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. You'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. We also value work-life harmony — achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture.

Basic qualifications

- - Troubleshoot networking, routing, and connectivity issues including network device configuration and cabling infrastructure.
- - Experience with hardware troubleshooting and repair.
- - Experience in networking with understanding infrastructure technologies (routers, switches, load balancers, firewalls) and protocols (HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP).
- - Knowledge of network cabling, optic types, and test equipment (VFL, power meter, OTDR).
- - Ability to specify power/cooling requirements, rack/stack hardware, and participate in migration and rollout of new equipment.
- - Able to lift/move computer equipment up to 15 kg with 2 persons or equipment support.
- - Fluency in English, and ability to travel (up to 20%, possibly international).

Preferred qualifications

- CCNA or equivalent level networking certification (e.g., CCENT, Network+), or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a relevant field.
- Experience managing medium-to-large-scale projects in data center environments.
- Strong understanding of CLI protocols (Cisco IOS, JunOS), networking protocols (BGP, OSPF), and infrastructure technologies (DWDM, routing/switching, network automation).
- Familiarity with programming or scripting skills used for task automation, tooling, or infrastructure management.
- Background in large-scale data center network implementations, support, and virtualized enterprise networking environments.
- Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective communication, and ability to prioritize tasks under pressure.
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.

title: Cloud Infra Architect, Migration, APJ-Delivery-Japan
descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムのアプリケーションの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？
Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にあるワークロードをAWSへのマイグレーションを支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的に加速できるようにプロジェクトをリードするCloud Infra Architectを募集しています。
お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産をクラウドへマイグレーションし、継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。しかし、移行・モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。マイグレーションとモダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現を支援するのが Cloud Infra Consultant です。オンプレミス環境の知識と経験を持ち、これらの上で稼働する様々なワークロードのクラウドへのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションに経験、興味のある方を求めています。

Key job responsibilities
当ポジションのコンサルタントは、お客様とパートナーのオンプレミス環境と稼働するワークロードの評価、計画、動員、設計、実行を支援します。AWS ProServeのコンサルタントは、スケーラブルな移行・モダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、オンプレミス環境よりクラウドへのマイグレーションおよびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。お客様の経営課題を把握しそれを実現する上で、現行システムのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションの最適アプローチとそれを実現する全体計画の策定を支援します。また、関係する技術コンサルタントとともに、移行・モダナイゼーションのための最適技術手法や技術選択肢の決定などを支援し、お客様が AWS のサービスを活用してスケーラブルで可用性の高いアプリケーションソリューションを構築できるよう支援します。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。
お客様の成功のために複数の Professional Services のメンバーやAWS パートナーのメンバー、そして、グローバルの Professional Services を含む社内の多くの AWS チームや AWS パートナーと連携し、価値提供にまい進することで技術者としての成長も期待できます。

#aws-jp-proserv-ap
#AWSJapan

Basic qualifications

- - お客様先でAWSの代表として、顧客のプロジェクト責任者と情報共有や議論を進めるコミュニケーションスキル
- - お客様、パートナー様、社内の他部門と連携しプロジェクトを進めるスキル
- - データベース環境の要件定義・設計・構築・導入のハンズオン経験とプロジェクトリード経験
- - データベース環境を含むシステムのオンプレミス環境→クラウド環境/オンプレミス環境等の移行プロジェクトにてアセスメント・計画・移行の経験
- - ビジネスレベルの日本語読解・ドキュメント作成・会話力
- - ***上記に加えて以下いずれかの経験
- - 可用性の高いシステムの設計とソリューション化に関する実務経験
- - 継続的インテグレーションプラットフォームの設計と実装に関する実務経験
- - エンタープライズにおけるネットワーク、コンピューティング、ストレージ、コンテナを含むクラウド実装の経験

Preferred qualifications

- - プロフェッショナルレベルのAWS認定取得
- - データベース関連の認定資格取得
- - データベースのオープン化などエンジン変更を伴う移行経験

- - 基幹システムをクラウド環境へ移行した経験

title: Infra Delivery Install Technician
descriptionHtml:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation

- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Chief Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.



AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).


Key job responsibilities
Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

Operate independently with limited direct management

Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures

Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.

Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.



Physical Requirements:

Walk job sites in uneven terrain

Work at heights and from ladders

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more

Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment

Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance

Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working

Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired

Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects

Push or pull heavy objects into position

Work in a noisy environment

Work at depths, such as under raised floors



This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting.
